failed.question:
A husband and wife entered into an agreement with a contractor to construct an addition to their home. The couple agreed to pay the contractor $75,000, with $10,000 to be paid upon the signing of the contract, progress payments of $25,000 to be made when the addition was one-third and two-thirds complete, and a final payment of $15,000 when the addition was complete. Immediately after the addition was two-thirds complete, and the contractor had received the payments called for under the contract, the contractor informed the couple that it would be unable to complete the addition. At that time, the contractor had incurred costs of $45,000 out of the $60,000 in costs that the contractor had anticipated incurring to complete the addition. The couple found another contractor to complete the addition at a cost of $35,000. The couple filed a breach of contract action against the first contractor, seeking expectation damages.
How much should the couple be awarded in damages?

A collector agreed to sell his collection of authentic extras' costumes from a cult-classic 80's show to a costume store for $10,000, payable one month after the collection was delivered to the store via a third-party carrier. Due to the time and expense that went into accumulating and repairing the costumes, the collector expected a $2,000 profit. The costumes suffered minor water damage in transit, and the store immediately notified the collector that it was rejecting the collection and would hold the collection until the collector picked it up. The collector told the store that he would look for a new buyer and would pick up the collection in a few weeks. The collector quickly found another buyer willing to pay the original contract price. However, before the collector could retrieve the collection, the store sold and delivered the costumes to a theater company that knowingly accepted the costumes despite the water damage. The theater company paid the store $15,000 for the collection, and the store retained the payment.
If the store's sale of the costumes was NOT an acceptance, what is the highest-value remedy available to the collector?

A lumber mill contracted with a trucking company to transport lumber from the mill to a residential contractor. The trucking company promised the mill that the lumber would arrive at the location specified in the contract on August 1. However, the contract contained a clause providing that the trucking company would not be liable for any losses suffered by the mill as a result of a late shipment. The trucking company was aware that the mill had contracted with the contractor to deliver the lumber on August 1, and that the price to be paid by the contractor decreased for each day that the lumber was late. The shipment of lumber did not reach the contractor until August 10, and the trucking company had no justification for the delay. Because of the delay, the mill lost revenue from the sale in excess of the cost to transport the lumber to the contractor. The mill filed suit against the trucking company for breach of contract, claiming damages based on its lost revenue.
Is the mill likely to succeed in its claim for these damages?

A job-search website provided consumers with online access to job openings based upon the consumer's location and specific area of expertise. The website wanted to expand the usefulness of its services, so it hired a production company to produce instructional videos regarding the job-hiring process, ranging from how to write a resume to interviewing tips. The written agreement dated September 20 stipulated that the production company would produce 10 five-minute instructional videos regarding the interview process based upon the general guidelines provided by the website regarding video content. The website agreed to pay $1,500 for each video, provided that the video was in high definition. The contract called for all of the videos to be completed by November 20. Due to issues regarding the availability of video cameras, the production company delivered the 10 videos in standard definition on November 30. Nonetheless, the website used the standard-definition videos, but it refused to pay the production company for its services.
Can the production company recover any damages from the website for providing the 10 videos in standard definition on November 30?

A landowner contracted in a signed writing to sell a 500-acre tract of farmland to a farmer. The contract provided for exchange of the deed and purchase price of $500,000 in cash on January 15. Possession was to be given to the farmer on the same date.
On January 15, the landowner notified the farmer that because the tenant on the farmland wrongfully refused to quit the premises until January 30, the landowner would be unable to deliver possession of the farmland until then, but he assured the farmer that he would tender the deed and possession on that date. When the landowner tendered the deed and possession on January 30, the farmer refused to accept either, and refused to pay the $500,000. Throughout the month of January, the market value of the farmland was $510,000, and its fair monthly rental value was $5,000.
Will the landowner likely succeed in an action against the farmer for specific performance?

A bakery contracted with a mill to provide 10,000 pounds of flour for $100,000. Prior to the date fixed for delivery of the flour, the mill, without justification, informed the bakery that it could not supply the flour. The bakery immediately sought and received a quote from a second source, who previously provided the bakery with flour in a timely and satisfactory manner. This source agreed to sell 10,000 pounds of flour for $120,000. Shortly after that, the bakery received a quote from a third source, who previously failed to deliver a promised order of flour to the bakery. The third source agreed to supply 10,000 pounds of flour for $100,000. Reasonably concerned that the third source would not provide the flour in a timely and satisfactory manner, the bakery contracted with the second source. Subsequently, the mill told the bakery that it could supply the flour by the original delivery date and provided the bakery with adequate evidence that the flour would be timely delivered. The bakery told the mill not to deliver the flour, instead acquiring it from the second source. The bakery sued the mill for $20,000.
Can the mill successfully defend against this action?

questions.question:
A painter contracted with an apartment manager to paint three identical apartment units for $1,000 each. The contract provided for the manager's payment of $3,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three units. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first unit was completely painted, but she demanded $2,000 after painting the second unit. Assume that the manager rightfully refused the painter's demand for payment.
If the painter immediately terminates the contract without painting the third unit, what is the painter entitled to recover from the manager?

choices.a: Nothing, because payment was expressly conditioned on completion of all three units.
choices.b: The amount equal to the increase in the combined value of the two painted units resulting from the painter's work.
choices.c: The painter's expenditures plus anticipated "profit" in painting the first two units, up to a maximum recovery of $2,000.
choices.d: The reasonable value of the painter's services in painting the two units, less the manager's damages, if any, for the painter's failure to paint the third unit.

data.questionStem:
Q81191

A painter contracted with an apartment manager to paint three identical apartment units for $1,000 each. The contract provided for the manager's payment of $3,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three units. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first unit was completely painted, but she demanded $2,000 after painting the second unit. Assume that the manager rightfully refused the painter's demand for payment.

If the painter immediately terminates the contract without painting the third unit, what is the painter entitled to recover from the manager?

一位油漆工与一位公寓经理签订合同，为三套相同的公寓单元进行粉刷，每套1000美元。合同规定，经理应在油漆工完成所有三套单元的粉刷工作后支付3000美元。油漆工在完成第一套单元的粉刷后没有要求任何付款，但在粉刷完第二套单元后，她要求支付2000美元。假设经理正当地拒绝了油漆工的付款要求。

如果油漆工在未粉刷第三套单元的情况下立即终止合同，她有权向经理追偿什么？
options:
A. Nothing, because payment was expressly conditioned on completion of all three unites.
什么也得不到，因为付款的明确条件是完成所有三套单元的粉刷。

B. The amount equal to the increase in the combined value of the two painted units resulting from the painter's work.
与油漆工的工作所导致的两套已粉刷单元的合计价值增值相等的金额。

C. The painter's expenditures plus anticipated "profit" in painting the first two units, up to a maximum recovery of $2,000.
油漆工在粉刷前两套单元时的支出加上预期“利润”，最高追偿额为2000美元。

D. The reasonable value of the painter's services in painting the two units, less the manager's damages, if any, for the painter's failure to paint the third unit.
油漆工粉刷两套单元所提供服务的合理价值，减去经理因油漆工未能粉刷第三套单元而遭受的任何损害赔偿。
data.explanation:
Restitutionary damages


DefinitionDamages awarded to restore to claimant the value of whatever benefit was conferred upon recipient
PurposePrevent unjust enrichment
MeasureReasonable value of work performed or services rendered (ie, cost of recipient obtaining comparable performance) If applicable, extent to which recipient's property has increased in value or recipient's other interests have been advanced
In the event of breach, the breaching party can recover restitutionary damages for the reasonable value of the work performed before the breach, less any damages suffered by the nonbreaching party. Restitutionary damages ensure that the nonbreaching party is not unjustly enriched by the work performed by the breaching party prior to the breach.

Here, the painter breached the contract by immediately terminating the contract after the apartment manager rightfully refused the painter's early payment demand. As the breaching party, the painter is entitled to the reasonable value of her services in painting the two units, less the manager's damages, if any, for her failure to paint the third unit (eg, the increased cost of another painter) (Choices A & B).

(Choice C) A nonbreaching party who has partially performed can generally recover for the costs of the work performed plus expectation damages (ie, anticipated profits). But here the painter is the breaching party and so is not entitled to recover this amount.

Educational objective: The breaching party can recover restitutionary damages for the reasonable value of the work performed before the breach, less any damages suffered by the nonbreaching party.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 3%，C选项 5%，D选项 76%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

恢复原状损害赔偿


定义旨在将授予接受方的利益价值返还给索赔人的损害赔偿
目的防止不当得利
衡量标准已完成工作或已提供服务的合理价值（即接受方获得可比履行所付出的成本）。如适用，接受方财产的增值程度或其其他利益的增进程度。
在发生违约时，违约方可以就其在违约前已完成工作的合理价值获得恢复原状损害赔偿，但需减去非违约方遭受的任何损害赔偿。恢复原状损害赔偿确保非违约方不会因违约方在违约前所完成的工作而不当得利。

在本案中，油漆工在公寓经理正当地拒绝其提前付款要求后立即终止合同，从而构成违约。作为违约方，油漆工有权获得其粉刷两套单元所提供服务的合理价值，但需减去经理因其未能粉刷第三套单元而遭受的任何损害赔偿（例如，另雇油漆工增加的费用）（选项 A 与 B）。

（选项 C） 一个已经部分履行的非违约方，通常可以追偿已完成工作的成本加上预期损害赔偿（即预期利润）。但在本案中，油漆工是违约方，因此无权追偿该金额。

教学目标： 违约方可以就其在违约前已完成工作的合理价值获得恢复原状损害赔偿，但需减去非违约方遭受的任何损害赔偿。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 371 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (measure of restitution interest).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (restitution in favor of breaching party).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
核心考点：违约方的恢复原状请求权

即使一方实质性违约 (Material Breach)，现代合同法（如 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374）通常也允许违约方追偿，以防止非违约方获得不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。

本题中，油漆工在完成 2/3 的工作后无正当理由退出，属于违约方 (Breaching Party)。此时她不能基于合同起诉（因为她自己违约了），但可以基于准合同 (Quasi-Contract) 请求恢复原状 (Restitution)。

违约方可追偿金额计算公式
已提供服务的合理价值 (Reasonable Value of Services)
－ (减去)
非违约方的损害赔偿 (Damages caused by breach)

选项深度解析

选项 D (正确答案)

"油漆工粉刷两套单元所提供服务的合理价值，减去经理因油漆工未能粉刷第三套单元而遭受的任何损害赔偿。"

这是标准的恢复原状 (Restitution) 计算方式。虽然油漆工违约了，但经理确实收到了粉刷两套公寓的利益。法律要求经理支付这部分利益的价值，但允许经理扣除因不得不另找人完成第三套公寓而产生的额外费用。

选项 A (错误)

这是旧普通法的严格规则。现代法律倾向于避免没收 (Forfeiture)。如果仅仅因为没有完全履行就一分钱拿不到，会导致经理不当得利（白白享受了两套公寓的粉刷服务）。

选项 C (错误)

这是非违约方通常享有的预期利益 (Expectation Damages) 计算方式（成本 + 利润）。因为油漆工是违约方，她无权要求合同利润，只能要求已提供服务的实际价值。

💡 MBE 答题技巧：
遇到合同救济题，首先判断谁违约了。
  • 如果是受害方起诉：通常拿预期利益 (Expectation Damages)，即让他处于“仿佛合同被履行”的状态。
  • 如果是违约方起诉：只能拿恢复原状 (Restitution)，即“防止对方白拿好处”，且必须扣除给对方造成的损失。

questions.question:
In January, a teacher contracted with a summer camp to serve as its head counselor at a salary of $10,000 for 10 weeks, from the first of June to the middle of August. In March, the camp notified the teacher that it had hired someone else as head counselor and that the teacher's services would not be needed.
In April, the teacher spent $200 traveling to interview at the only other nearby summer camp for a position as its head counselor. She was not chosen for that job. The teacher then took a position teaching in a local summer school at a salary of $6,000 for the same 10-week period.
How much is the teacher entitled to recover as damages in a breach-of-contract action against the camp?

data.questionStem:
Q81206

In January, a teacher contracted with a summer camp to serve as its head counselor at a salary of $10,000 for 10 weeks, from the first of June to the middle of August. In March, the camp notified the teacher that it had hired someone else as head counselor and that the teacher's services would not be needed.

In April, the teacher spent $200 traveling to interview at the only other nearby summer camp for a position as its head counselor. She was not chosen for that job. The teacher then took a position teaching in a local summer school at a salary of $6,000 for the same 10-week period.

How much is the teacher entitled to recover as damages in a breach-of-contract action against the camp?

一月，一名教师与一个夏令营签订合同，担任其首席辅导员，为期10周，从六月初到八月中旬，薪水为10,000美元。三月，该夏令营通知该教师，其已雇佣他人担任首席辅导员，不再需要该教师的服务。

四月，该教师花费200美元差旅费，前往附近唯一的另一个夏令营面试首席辅导员一职。她未被录用。随后，该教师在当地一所暑期学校任教，薪水为6,000美元，工作时间与前合同同样为期10周。

在该教师对该夏令营提起的违约诉讼中，她有权获得多少损害赔偿金？
data.explanation:
Expectation (ie, benefit-of-the-bargain) damages


DefinitionLosses arising naturally & obviously from breach
PurposePlace nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been performed
Measure
  • General rule - difference between contract price & market price (or cost of purchasing substitute performance)
  • Construction contracts - difference between contract price & cost of construction by another builder
The primary purpose of contract damages is to place the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been performed; therefore, the nonbreaching party is entitled to recover expectation damages. Calculating these damages begins with the contract price, but any losses that the nonbreaching party avoided or could have avoided (ie, mitigated) after the breach are subtracted from the total damage award. Reasonable expenses incurred in an effort to mitigate damages, whether or not successful, are recoverable.

Here, the teacher contracted to serve as the summer camp's head counselor at a salary of $10,000 for 10 weeks. After the summer camp breached the contract by hiring someone else, the teacher found substitute employment at a salary of $6,000 for the same 10-week period. As a result, the teacher can recover expectation damages of $4,000 ($10,000 — $6,000). In addition, the teacher can recover the $200 in travel expenses incurred in attempting to find substitute employment (Choice A). Therefore, the teacher is entitled to recover $4,200 in total.

(Choices C & D) The summer camp and summer school jobs were for the same 10-week period - ie, the teacher could not have worked both jobs simultaneously. Consequently, $10,000 (or $10,200) would overcompensate the teacher for her loss rather than place her in the same position had the contract been performed.

Educational objective: Any losses that the nonbreaching party avoided or could have avoided (ie, mitigated) post-breach are subtracted from the total damage award. However, reasonable expenses incurred in an effort to mitigate damages are recoverable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 79%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

期待性（即交易利益）损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)


定义因违约而自然且明显产生的损失
目的使非违约方处于合同得以履行情况下的同等地位
计算方法
  • 一般规则 - 合同价格与市场价格（或购买替代履行的成本）之间的差额
  • 建筑合同 - 合同价格与由另一建筑商施工的成本之间的差额
合同损害赔偿金的主要目的是使非违约方处于合同若得以履行其本应处于的同等地位；因此，非违约方有权追偿期待性损害赔偿 (expectation damages)。计算这些损害赔偿金时，以合同价格为起点，但违约后非违约方已避免或本可避免（即，已减损）的任何损失，都将从损害赔偿金总额中扣除。为努力减损而产生的合理费用，无论减损努力是否成功，均可追偿。

在本案中，该教师与夏令营签订合同，担任其首席辅导员，为期10周，薪水为10,000美元。在夏令营通过雇佣他人而违约后，该教师找到了薪水为6,000美元的替代工作，工作时间同为10周。因此，该教师可以追偿4,000美元的期待性损害赔偿金（$10,000 - $6,000）。此外，该教师还可以追偿为尝试寻找替代工作而产生的200美元差旅费（选项A）。因此，该教师总共有权追偿4,200美元。

（选项C和D）夏令营和暑期学校的工作都在同一个10周的期间内——即，该教师无法同时从事这两份工作。因此，10,000美元（或10,200美元）的赔偿金将对教师的损失构成过度补偿，而不是使她处于合同得以履行情况下的同等地位。

教学目标：任何非违约方在违约后已避免或本可避免（即，已减损）的损失，都将从损害赔偿金总额中扣除。然而，为努力减损而产生的合理费用是可追偿的。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
正确答案：B ($4,200)
核心法律原则 期待利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)
目的是让非违约方处于“如同合同已完全履行”的经济地位。

在雇佣合同违约案件中，当雇主违约时，雇员有权获得的赔偿金计算逻辑如下：

合同约定薪资 $10,000
(-) 减损收入 (Mitigated Income) - $6,000
(+) 附带损害 (Incidental Damages) + $200
总赔偿额 $4,200

详细解析

1. 减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate)：
根据普通法，非违约方有义务采取合理措施减少损失。在本案中，教师在违约后找到了一份新的工作，薪水为 $6,000。

由于这两份工作是在同一时间段（10周），教师无法同时从事这两份工作。如果法院判给她全额 $10,000 加上她新赚的 $6,000，她的总收入将达到 $16,000，这会使她的处境优于合同履行时的处境（不当得利）。因此，必须从赔偿金中扣除她通过替代工作赚取的 $6,000。

2. 附带损害 (Incidental Damages)：
教师为了寻找替代工作花费了 $200 的差旅费。虽然那次面试没有成功，但这笔费用是她在违约后为履行减损义务而产生的合理费用。

无论减损尝试是否成功，只要是合理的尝试，产生的费用均可作为附带损害进行追偿。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在计算违约赔偿金时，请牢记这个公式：
赔偿金 = 预期收益 - 避免的损失/成本 + 附带/间接损害

陷阱警示： 选项 A ($4,000) 忽略了寻找工作的成本；选项 C ($10,000) 忽略了减损收入；选项 D ($10,200) 虽然加回了成本，但忘记扣除新工作的收入。

questions.question:
A brick mason was hired by a builder under a written one-year contract, at an annual salary of $45,000, with employment to begin on March 1. Because the builder was unable to secure enough building contracts to keep all its employees busy during the season beginning March 1, it notified the brick mason on February 15 that it could not afford to employ him as a mason. At the same time, however, the builder offered to employ the mason, for the same contract period, as a night guard at an annual salary of $25,000. The mason declined the offer and remained unemployed during the year. No employment for brick masons was available in the community during the year, but the mason could have obtained other employment as a day laborer that would have paid up to $25,000 a year.
At the end of the year, in an action against the builder for breach of contract, how much, if anything, is the mason entitled to recover?

choices.a: $20,000 (the $45,000 contract price less the $25,000 the mason could have earned in other employment).
choices.b: $45,000 (the contract price).
choices.c: Nothing, because the builder did not act in bad faith when it discharged the mason.
choices.d: Nothing, because the mason did not mitigate his damages.

The mason declined the offer and remained unemployed during the year. No employment for brick masons was available in the community during the year, but the mason could have obtained other employment as a day laborer that would have paid up to $25,000 a year.

At the end of the year, in an action against the builder for breach of contract, how much, if anything, is the mason entitled to recover? 一名砖瓦匠被一个建筑商根据一份为期一年的书面合同雇用，年薪为$45,000，雇佣期从3月1日开始。由于建筑商未能获得足够的建筑合同以使其所有员工在3月1日开始的季节里保持忙碌，它于2月15日通知该砖瓦匠，无法负担雇用他作为瓦匠的费用。然而，与此同时，建筑商提出在同一合同期内以$25,000的年薪雇用该瓦匠担任夜间警卫。该瓦匠拒绝了这份提议，并在该年内一直失业。该年内，社区中没有砖瓦匠的工作机会，但该瓦匠本可以找到其他日工工作，年薪可达$25,000。

在该年年底，在一场针对建筑商的违约诉讼中，该瓦匠有权获得多少赔偿（如果有的话）？
options:
A. $20,000 (the $45,000 contract price less the $25,000 the mason could have earned in other employment).
$20,000（$45,000的合同价款减去该瓦匠在其他工作中本可以赚取的$25,000）。

B. $45,000 (the contract price).
$45,000（合同价款）。

C. Nothing, because the builder did not act in bad faith when it discharged the mason.
无权获得赔偿，因为建筑商在解雇该瓦匠时没有恶意行为。

D. Nothing, because the mason did not mitigate his damages.
无权获得赔偿，因为该瓦匠没有减轻其损失。
data.explanation:
Purpose of compensatory damages


Primary

(expectation
measure)		Place nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been
performed

Expectation measure includes:
Expectation damages
Incidental damages
Consequential damages
Fallback

(reliance
measure)		When expectation measure too speculative, place nonbreaching party
in same position as if no contract had been formed

Reliance measure includes:
Reliance damages
Liquidated damages
Restitution
A nonbreaching party's remedies for breach include compensatory damages—ie, a sum of money that would put that party in the same position as if the contract had been performed. Therefore, when an employer breaches an employment agreement, the employee is entitled to recover the unpaid salary under the contract. The employee's total recovery will be reduced, however, by compensation the employee earned or could have earned had he/she made reasonable efforts to secure comparable employment (ie, mitigate damages).

Here, the builder breached the employment contract before the brick mason's employment began. As a result, the mason can seek compensatory damages for his unpaid salary under the contract. And since there was no masonry work available in the community for the one-year contract period, the mason could not reasonably mitigate his damages by securing comparable employment. Therefore, the mason is entitled to recover the full $45,000 contract price (Choices A & D).

(Choice C) A lack of bad faith (ie, dishonesty or improper motive) does not excuse a party from paying damages after breaching a contract.

Educational objective: When an employer breaches an employment agreement, the employee can recover the unpaid salary under the contract. That recovery is reduced by the compensation the employee earned or could have earned by making reasonable efforts to secure comparable employment.

补偿性损害赔偿金的目的


主要

（预期
标准）		将非违约方置于合同如同已被履行的相同位置

预期标准包括：
预期损害赔偿金
附带损害赔偿金
间接损害赔偿金
备用

（信赖
标准）		当预期标准过于投机时，将非违约方
置于合同如同未曾订立的相同位置

信赖标准包括：
信赖损害赔偿金
违约金
返还
非违约方因违约可获得的救济包括补偿性损害赔偿金——即一笔能使该方处于合同如同已被履行的相同位置的款项。因此，当雇主违反雇佣协议时，雇员有权根据合同收回未付薪水。然而，雇员的总赔偿额将扣减其在做出合理努力以获得可比工作（即减轻损害）后已经赚取或本可以赚取的报酬。

在此案中，建筑商在砖瓦匠的雇佣期开始前违反了雇佣合同。因此，该瓦匠可以就其根据合同未获支付的薪水寻求补偿性损害赔偿。并且，由于在为期一年的合同期内，社区中没有可获得的瓦匠工作，该瓦匠无法通过获得可比工作来合理地减轻其损失。因此，该瓦匠有权获得全部$45,000的合同价款（因此选项A和D不正确）。

（选项C）缺乏恶意（即不诚实或不正当动机）并不能免除一方在违约后支付损害赔偿金的责任。

教学目标： 当雇主违反雇佣协议时，雇员可以收回合同规定的未付薪水。该赔偿额将扣减雇员通过做出合理努力以获得可比工作而已经赚取或本可以赚取的报酬。

MBE Contracts Analysis

雇佣合同违约与减轻损害

⚖️ 核心法律规则 当雇主违反雇佣合同时，雇员有权获得预期利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)。

计算公式：
合同薪资 - 雇员本可以避免的损失

*“本可以避免的损失”指雇员通过合理努力找到可比工作 (Comparable Employment) 能赚取的收入。

📝 案情逻辑推演

1违约责任确立

建筑商在合同开始前通知无法雇佣，构成了预期违约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。砖瓦匠有权获得赔偿。

2减轻损害义务 (Duty to Mitigate)

这是本题的关键。受害方有义务采取合理措施减轻损失，即寻找新工作。但是，法律不要求受害方接受以下类型的工作：

  • 不同类型 (Different in kind)
  • 低级/劣等 (Inferior)
3工作性质对比

原职位：砖瓦匠 (Brick Mason) —— 熟练技术工种。
替代职位1：夜间警卫 (Night Guard) —— 性质完全不同。
替代职位2：日工 (Day Laborer) —— 通常被视为比熟练技工“低级”或性质不同。

因此，砖瓦匠没有法律义务接受这两份工作来减轻建筑商的赔偿责任。

🧮 赔偿金计算

合同约定薪资 $45,000
减：已赚取的收入 - $0
减：本应赚取的可比收入
(Avoidable damages)		 - $0 *
最终赔偿额 $45,000

* 注：题目明确指出社区内没有其他的砖瓦匠工作 (No employment for brick masons was available)，因此可减扣金额为0。

🚫 为什么选项 A ($20,000) 是错误的？
选项 A 错误地扣除了 $25,000。虽然砖瓦匠“本可以”赚到这笔钱，但法律不强迫他去从事“日工”或“警卫”的工作。只有当他拒绝了同等的砖瓦匠工作时，这笔钱才会被扣除。
🚫 为什么选项 C 是错误的？
合同法是严格责任 (Strict Liability)。违约方的动机（是否恶意 Bad Faith）与是否需要支付补偿性赔偿金无关。即使雇主是因为破产或经济困难而违约，仍需赔偿。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理雇佣合同违约题时，如果题目给出了替代工作机会，请务必检查该工作是否与原工作“实质相似” (Substantially Similar)。

如果替代工作涉及：

  • 不同的地点 (Different location)
  • 不同的工种 (Different kind)
  • 较低的地位/声望 (Inferior rank/status)

那么雇员没有义务接受它，拒绝该工作不会减少可获得的赔偿金。

questions.question:
A buyer and a seller entered into a contract for the sale of 10,000 novelty bracelets. The seller had the bracelets in stock. The contract specified that the seller would ship the bracelets by a third-party carrier. However, the contract did not specify either who was to pay the costs of carriage or the place of tender for the bracelets.
On the above facts, when would the risk of loss of the bracelets pass to the buyer?

choices.a: When the bracelets were delivered to a carrier and a proper contract for their carriage was made.
choices.b: When the bracelets were identified to the contract by the seller, assuming that the goods conformed to the contract.
choices.c: When the bracelets were unloaded on the buyer's premises by the carrier.
choices.d: When the contract was made.

data.questionStem:
Q81211

A buyer and a seller entered into a contract for the sale of 10,000 novelty bracelets. The seller had the bracelets in stock. The contract specified that the seller would ship the bracelets by a third-party carrier. However, the contract did not specify either who was to pay the costs of carriage or the place of tender for the bracelets.

On the above facts, when would the risk of loss of the bracelets pass to the buyer?

买方和卖方签订了一份销售10,000个新奇手镯的合同。卖方有这些手镯的库存。合同规定卖方将通过第三方承运人运送手镯。但是，合同既未明确由谁支付运输费用，也未明确手镯的交付地点。

基于上述事实，手镯的损失风险何时转移给买方？
options:
A. When the bracelets were delivered to a carrier and a proper contract for their carriage was made.
当手镯交付给承运人，并为其运输签订了适当的合同时。

B. When the bracelets were identified to the contract by the seller, assuming that the goods conformed to the contract.
当卖方确定了合同项下的手镯，且假定货物符合合同约定时。

C. When the bracelets were unloaded on the buyer's premises by the carrier.
当承运人在买方的营业场所卸下手镯时。

D. When the contract was made.
当合同订立时。
data.explanation:
Risk of loss in the absence of breach

(UCC § 2-509)
General ruleIf seller is merchant, risk of loss passes to buyer when buyer takes physical possession of goods If not, risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are delivered
Goods to be shipped by carrierShipment contract (presumed) - risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are given to carrier & proper contract for shipment is made Destination contract - risk of loss passes to buyer when goods are delivered at place specified in contract
Goods to be held by baileeRisk of loss passes to buyer when: buyer receives negotiable document of title covering goods (eg, warehouse receipt) or bailee (eg, warehouseman) acknowledges buyer's right to possess goods
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, novelty bracelets - as seen here) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, the risk of loss generally passes to the buyer when the buyer receives the goods. But if the contract requires the seller to deliver the goods through a third-party carrier, the risk of loss passes to the buyer at different times depending on whether the contract is a:
  • shipment contract † - a contract that does not require delivery at a particular location, in which case the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered to the carrier and a proper contract for their shipment is made or
  • destination contract - a contract that requires delivery at a particular location, in which case the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered at the place specified in the contract


Here, the contract between the buyer and the seller specified that the seller would ship the goods by a third-party carrier but did not specify the place of tender (ie, delivery) for the bracelets. As a result, it is a shipment contract, and the risk of loss would pass to the buyer when the bracelets were delivered to a third-party carrier and a proper contract for their carriage (ie, shipment) was made (Choices B, C & D).

†The UCC presumes that a contract is a shipment contract unless it contains a "free on board" term or other term explicitly allocating the risk of loss. Merely indicating a shipping address does not make a contract a destination contract.

Educational objective: A contract that requires the seller to deliver the goods by third-party carrier but does not specify a delivery location is a shipment contract. Under such a contract, the risk of loss shifts to the buyer when the seller delivers the goods to the carrier and makes a proper contract for their shipment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 70%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 24%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在无违约情况下的损失风险

(UCC § 2-509)
一般规则如果卖方是商人，损失风险在买方实际占有货物时转移给买方。如果不是商人，损失风险在货物交付时转移给买方。
由承运人运输的货物发货合同（推定） - 当货物交给承运人并签订了适当的运输合同时，损失风险转移给买方。
到货合同 - 当货物在合同指定地点交付时，损失风险转移给买方。
由受托人持有的货物损失风险在以下情况转移给买方：买方收到涵盖货物的可转让所有权凭证（例如，仓单）或受托人（例如，仓管员）承认买方拥有货物的权利。
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (《统一商法典》)

货物（例如，本案中的新奇手镯）销售合同受Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) 第二条管辖。根据UCC的规定，损失风险通常在买方收到货物时转移给买方。但如果合同要求卖方通过第三方承运人交付货物，则损失风险转移给买方的时间点，会因合同是以下哪种类型而有所不同：
  • 发货合同† - 该合同不要求在特定地点交货，在这种情况下，当货物交付给承运人并为其运输签订了适当的合同时，损失风险即转移给买方；或
  • 到货合同 - 该合同要求在特定地点交货，在这种情况下，当货物在合同指定的地点交付时，损失风险即转移给买方。


在本案中，买卖双方的合同规定卖方将通过第三方承运人运送货物，但未明确手镯的交付地点。因此，这是一份发货合同，损失风险将在手镯交付给第三方承运人并为其运输（即装运）签订适当合同时转移给买方（因此选项B、C和D不正确）。

†UCC推定合同为发货合同，除非合同中包含“船上交货”(free on board)条款或其他明确分配损失风险的条款。仅仅指明一个送货地址并不会使合同成为到货合同。

教学目的：要求卖方通过第三方承运人交付货物但未指定交货地点的合同是发货合同。在此类合同下，当卖方将货物交付给承运人并为其运输签订适当合同时，损失风险转移给买方。

References

U.C.C. § 2-509 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (risk of loss in the absence of breach).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Risk of Loss (损失风险)

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (UCC § 2-509) 在涉及第三方承运人 (Third-Party Carrier) 的货物买卖中，如果合同未明确规定交付地点，UCC 默认该合同为发货合同 (Shipment Contract)。

本题考察的是 UCC 下货物损失风险 (Risk of Loss) 的转移时间点。这是 MBE 合同法部分的高频考点。

1. 区分两种合同类型

当卖方被授权通过承运人运送货物时，合同分为两类：

  • 发货合同 (Shipment Contract)：卖方只需将货物交给承运人。风险在“交付给承运人”时转移。
  • 到货合同 (Destination Contract)：卖方必须将货物运送到特定目的地。风险在“到达目的地并提交交付”时转移。
2. 默认推定 (Presumption)

关键考点：除非合同中有明确的条款（如 "F.O.B. Buyer's Place"）要求卖方在特定地点交付，否则 UCC 强烈推定合同为发货合同。

📝 案情应用

1
合同规定使用第三方承运人。
2
合同未指定交付地点 (Place of tender)。
3
结论：这是一个发货合同 (Shipment Contract)。

在发货合同下，损失风险在卖方完成以下义务时转移给买方：

  1. 将货物交付给承运人；
  2. 签订合理的运输合同；
  3. 通知买方（通常要求）。

因此，选项 A 正确描述了发货合同下风险转移的时间点。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B (Identification):
错误。货物特定化 (Identification) 发生在风险转移之前。仅仅确定货物属于合同项下，并不转移损失风险。
选项 C (Unloading/Destination):
错误。这是到货合同 (Destination Contract) 的规则。只有当合同明确规定了 "F.O.B. [Buyer's Location]" 时，风险才会在买方处卸货/交付时转移。本题未指定地点，故不适用。
选项 D (Contract Made):
错误。对于非特定物的销售，风险绝不会在合同订立时立即转移，卖方仍需履行交付义务。
💡 MBE 答题技巧：
看到 "Ship by carrier" 且没有 "F.O.B." 条款？
直接选 Shipment Contract (交给承运人时转移风险)。

questions.question:
A buyer ordered a new machine from a manufacturer. The machine arrived on time and conformed in all respects to the contract. The buyer, however, rejected the machine because he no longer needed it in his business and returned the machine to the manufacturer. The manufacturer sold many such machines each year, and its factory was not operating at full capacity.
In an action by the manufacturer against the buyer for breach of contract, which of the following is NOT a proper measure of the manufacturer's damages?

choices.a: The contract price of the machine.
choices.b: The difference between the contract price and the market price of the machine.
choices.c: The difference between the contract price and the price obtained from a proper resale of the machine.
choices.d: The profit the manufacturer would have made on the sale of the machine to the buyer.

data.questionStem:
Q81190

A buyer ordered a new machine from a manufacturer. The machine arrived on time and conformed in all respects to the contract. The buyer, however, rejected the machine because he no longer needed it in his business and returned the machine to the manufacturer. The manufacturer sold many such machines each year, and its factory was not operating at full capacity.

In an action by the manufacturer against the buyer for breach of contract, which of the following is NOT a proper measure of the manufacturer's damages?

一位买方向一家制造商订购了一台新机器。该机器按时送达，且各方面均与合同相符。然而，买方因其业务不再需要该机器而拒收，并将机器退还给制造商。该制造商每年销售许多此类机器，且其工厂未满负荷运营。

在制造商因买方违约而提起的诉讼中，以下哪一项不是制造商损害赔偿的适当计算方法？
options:
A. The contract price of the machine.
该机器的合同价格。

B. The difference between the contract price and the market price of the machine.
该机器的合同价格与市场价格之间的差额。

C. The difference between the contract price and the price obtained from a proper resale of the machine.
合同价格与适当转售该机器所得价格之间的差额。

D. The profit the manufacturer would have made on the sale of the machine to the buyer.
制造商本应通过向该买方销售该机器而获得的利润。
data.explanation:
Seller's action for contract price of goods


(UCC § 2-709) When buyer fails to pay for goods, seller can recover contract price of goods† if:
  • buyer accepted goods
  • goods were lost/damaged within commercially reasonable time after risk of loss passed to buyer
  • or buyer returned or rejected goods & seller was unable after reasonable efforts to resell them
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

†Seller can also recover incidental damages

Under the UCC , when a buyer fails to pay for goods, the seller can recover the contract price of the goods under three circumstances:
  • Where the buyer accepted the goods
  • Where the goods were lost or damaged within a commercially reasonable time after the risk of loss had passed to the buyer
  • Where the buyer returned or rejected the goods and the seller was unable after reasonable efforts to resell them


The seller is also entitled to any incidental damages arising from the transport, resale, or other action taken incident to the buyer's breach.

Here, the buyer rejected the machine (no acceptance) and returned it intact to the manufacturer (no loss/damage). And since the manufacturer sold many of these machines each year and its factory was not operating at full capacity, it should be able to resell the buyer's machine. Therefore, the machine's contract price is not a proper measure of the manufacturer's damages.

(Choices B & C) A nonbreaching seller can recover the difference between the contract price and the market price of the goods at the time of tender. Alternatively, the seller can resell the goods for a reasonable price and recover the difference between the contract price and the resale price. As a result, either could be a proper measure of the seller's damages.

(Choice D) The manufacturer is a lost-volume seller, as evidenced by the fact that it sold many of these machines each year and was not operating at full capacity. Lost-volume sellers can recover lost profits because, but for the buyer's breach, they could have made two sales (and two profits) rather than one.

Educational objective:

A seller can only recover the contract price of the goods after the buyer failed to pay if (1) the buyer accepted the goods, (2) the goods were lost or damaged within a commercially reasonable time after the risk of loss passed to the buyer, or (3) the buyer returned or rejected the goods and the seller could not resell them.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 36%（正确选项），B选项 34%，C选项 10%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方就货物合同价款提起的诉讼


(UCC § 2-709) 当买方未能支付货物价款时，卖方可在以下情况下要求赔偿货物的合同价款†：
  • 买方已接受货物
  • 货物在灭失风险转移给买方后的商业合理时间内灭失或损坏
  • 或者买方退回或拒收货物，且卖方在做出合理努力后仍无法将其转售
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

†卖方还可要求赔偿附带损害

根据 UCC，当买方未能支付货物价款时，卖方可在以下三种情况下要求赔偿货物的合同价款：
  • 买方已接受货物
  • 货物在灭失风险转移给买方后的商业合理时间内灭失或损坏
  • 买方退回或拒收了货物，且卖方在做出合理努力后无法将其转售


卖方还有权要求赔偿因运输、转售或因买方违约而采取的其他行动所产生的任何附带损害。

在本案中，买方拒收了机器（即未接受），并将其完好无损地退还给制造商（即无灭失/损坏）。并且，由于该制造商每年销售许多此类机器，且其工厂未满负荷运营，因此应当能够转售买方退回的机器。因此，该机器的合同价格不是制造商损害赔偿的适当计算方法。

（选项B和C）未违约的卖方可以要求赔偿合同价格与货物交付时的市场价格之间的差额。作为替代方案，卖方可以以合理价格转售货物，并要求赔偿合同价格与转售价格之间的差额。因此，两者都可以是卖方损害赔偿的适当计算方法。

（选项D）该制造商是一个销量损失的卖方（lost-volume seller），证据是其每年销售许多此类机器且工厂未满负荷运营。销量损失的卖方可以要求赔偿损失的利润，因为若非买方违约，他们本可以完成两笔销售（并获得两份利润），而非一笔。

教学目标：

在买方未能付款的情况下，卖方只有在以下情况下才能要求赔偿货物的合同价款：（1）买方已接受货物，（2）货物在灭失风险转移给买方后的商业合理时间内灭失或损坏，或（3）买方退回或拒收货物且卖方无法将其转售。

UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

References

U.C.C. § 2-708 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (seller's damages - non-acceptance/repudiation).

U.C.C. § 2-709 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (action for price).

MBE 考点解析：卖方违约救济

核心考点： 本题考察《统一商法典》(UCC) 下卖方的损害赔偿计算方式，特别是“索取价款之诉” (Action for the Price) 的适用条件以及“销量损失型卖方” (Lost Volume Seller) 的概念。

题目要求选出不适当 (NOT a proper measure) 的赔偿方式。正确答案是 A。

1. 为什么选项 A 是错误的？

Action for the Price (UCC § 2-709)

选项 A 主张卖方可以获得“机器的合同价格”。在普通法和 UCC 中，这被称为“索取价款之诉”。这实际上是一种强制履行 (Specific Performance)，要求买方全额付款。

根据 UCC § 2-709，卖方只有在极少数特定情况下才能要求买方支付全额合同价款：

  • 买方已接受货物 (Accepted Goods)： 货物已被买方收下且未有效拒收。
  • 货物灭失或损坏： 风险转移给买方后，货物发生了灭失。
  • 无法转售 (Unresalable)： 卖方经合理努力无法将货物转售（例如：定制产品）。

本案分析：

  • 买方拒收 (Rejected) 了机器，并未接受。
  • 机器被完好退回，未灭失。
  • 最关键的是，这是一个标准机器，制造商每年销售许多台。这意味着卖方完全可以将这台机器卖给其他客户。

因此，卖方不能直接要求买方支付合同全款，而必须履行减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate)，即尝试转售。所以 A 是不适当的救济方式。

2. 为什么选项 D 是适当的？

Lost Volume Seller (UCC § 2-708(2))

这是本题的另一个重要考点。题目特别提到：“该制造商每年销售许多此类机器，且其工厂未满负荷运营 (not operating at full capacity)”。

这暗示卖方是一个“销量损失型卖方” (Lost Volume Seller)。

逻辑推理：

虽然卖方可以将这台机器卖给另一个客户（客户 B），但如果买方（客户 A）没有违约，卖方本可以：

  1. 卖一台给客户 A（赚取利润 1）；
  2. 并且卖另一台给客户 B（赚取利润 2）。

因为工厂产能未满，卖方有能力同时满足这两笔订单。买方违约导致卖方少赚了一份利润。

在这种情况下，简单的“合同价 - 转售价”无法弥补卖方的损失。因此，UCC 允许此类卖方索赔预期利润 (Lost Profit)。所以选项 D 是适当的。

3. 其他选项为何适当？

  • 选项 B (合同价 - 市场价)： 这是 UCC § 2-708(1) 规定的标准赔偿方式。
  • 选项 C (合同价 - 转售价)： 这是 UCC § 2-706 规定的标准赔偿方式（如果卖方进行了善意转售）。

注意：虽然对于“销量损失型卖方”来说，选项 D 通常能获得最多的赔偿，但法律并未禁止卖方选择 B 或 C（尽管在数学上对卖方可能不利）。题目问的是哪项在法律上不是适当的衡量标准，只有 A 是在法律上被严格限制而无法适用的。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到“工厂未满负荷” (unlimited supply / not at full capacity) 的字眼，立即联想 Lost Volume Seller。

如果看到“定制商品” (Custom-made goods) 且买方违约，通常可以选 Action for the Price（全额合同款）。如果是“标准商品” (Standard goods)，通常不能选全额合同款。

questions.question:
A well-established paper mill and a logging company signed a written contract in which the mill agreed to buy from the company all the logs the mill would need for one year. The company was unable to keep up with the mill's needs, and its log deliveries fell short by 10% to 15% in each of the four quarters of the year. The mill paid the company on time for all delivered logs.
The mill paid an attorney $2,000 for advice concerning its options in enforcing the contract. It paid a broker a reasonable fee of $5,000 to find additional logs to make up for the company's shortfall. The mill also incurred reasonable costs of $25,000 to transport the additional logs to its facility. Despite the mill's efforts to mitigate damages, it sustained an additional $200,000 in losses because of the company's failure to timely deliver enough logs.
The mill has sued the company for breach of contract.
If the court finds for the mill, how much should it award in damages?

data.questionStem:
Q81805 A well-established paper mill and a logging company signed a written contract in which the mill agreed to buy from the company all the logs the mill would need for one year. The company was unable to keep up with the mill's needs, and its log deliveries fell short by 10% to 15% in each of the four quarters of the year. The mill paid the company on time for all delivered logs.

The mill paid an attorney $2,000 for advice concerning its options in enforcing the contract. It paid a broker a reasonable fee of $5,000 to find additional logs to make up for the company's shortfall. The mill also incurred reasonable costs of $25,000 to transport the additional logs to its facility. Despite the mill's efforts to mitigate damages, it sustained an additional $200,000 in losses because of the company's failure to timely deliver enough logs.

The mill has sued the company for breach of contract.

If the court finds for the mill, how much should it award in damages? 一家信誉良好的造纸厂和一家伐木公司签订了一份书面合同，其中约定造纸厂向该公司购买其一年所需的所有原木。该伐木公司无法满足造纸厂的需求，其原木交付量在全年的四个季度中每个季度都短缺10%至15%。造纸厂按时支付了所有已交付原木的款项。

造纸厂支付了2000美元的律师费，以咨询其在执行合同方面的选择。它向一名经纪人支付了5000美元的合理费用，以寻找额外的原木来弥补该公司的短缺。造纸厂还承担了25000美元的合理费用，将额外的原木运输到其工厂。尽管造纸厂努力减轻损害，但由于该公司未能及时交付足够的原木，它还是遭受了20万美元的额外损失。

造纸厂已就违约起诉该公司。

如果法院裁定造纸厂胜诉，应判给其多少损害赔偿金？
data.explanation:
UCC damages for seller's breach when buyer covers


Cost of coverDifference between contract price & cost of purchasing substitute goods†
Incidental damagesReasonable expenses incurred in inspection, receipt, transportation & care of goods rightfully rejected
Commercially reasonable charges, expenses, or commissions incurred in connection with effecting cover
Other reasonable expenses incident to delay/breach
Consequential
damages		Losses resulting from buyer's particular circumstances that:
seller had reason to know at time of contracting and
could not reasonably be prevented
Injury to person/property proximately resulting from breach of warranty
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

†The substitute goods must have been purchased promptly & in good faith.

Under the UCC, the buyer can recover damages if the seller breaches the contract by failing to deliver some or all of the goods. If the buyer chooses to cover (ie, purchase substitute goods), then the buyer can recover the following:

Cost of cover – the difference between the contract price and the cost of purchasing substitute goods

Incidental damages – includes commercially reasonable charges, expenses, or commissions incurred in effecting cover (eg, transportation costs, broker commission)

Consequential damages – includes losses resulting from the buyer's particular circumstances that (1) the seller had reason to know of at the time of contracting and (2) could not reasonably be prevented by cover or otherwise (eg, business losses)

No UCC provision provides for recovery of attorney's fees, however, so they are not recoverable in the absence of a contract provision allowing them. In addition, although a party has no duty to mitigate its losses, its recovery will be reduced by the amount that could have been reasonably avoided or minimized.

Here, the paper mill will necessarily recover the $200,000 in losses it sustained because of the logging company's failure to deliver enough logs. These are presumably consequential damages. The mill can also recover incidental damages of $25,000 for transporting the additional logs and $5,000 for the broker's commission—$30,000 in total. However, the $2,000 in attorney's fees are not recoverable (Choice D). Therefore, the court should award $230,000 in damages if it finds for the mill (Choices A & B).

买方补进时卖方违约的UCC损害赔偿


补进成本合同价格与购买替代品成本之间的差额†
附带损害赔偿因检验、接收、运输和保管被正当拒收的货物而产生的合理费用
在实施补进过程中产生的商业上合理的收费、开支或佣金
因延迟或违约而产生的其他合理费用
间接
损害赔偿		由买方的特殊情况造成的损失，并且：
卖方在订立合同时有理由知道且
无法合理预防
因违反担保而直接造成的人身或财产伤害
UCC =《统一商法典》。

†替代品必须是及时且善意购买的。

根据UCC，如果卖方因未能交付部分或全部货物而违约，买方可以获得损害赔偿。如果买方选择补进（即购买替代品），那么买方可以获得以下赔偿：

补进成本 – 合同价格与购买替代品成本之间的差额

附带损害赔偿 – 包括为实施补进而产生的商业上合理的收费、开支或佣金（例如，运输成本、经纪人佣金）

间接损害赔偿 – 包括由买方的特殊情况造成的损失，且(1)卖方在订立合同时有理由知道，并且(2)无法通过补进或其他方式合理预防（例如，营业损失）

然而，UCC中没有条款规定可以追偿律师费，因此，在没有合同条款允许的情况下，律师费是不可追偿的。此外，尽管一方没有义务减轻其损失，但其可获得的赔偿额将扣除本可合理避免或减少的金额。

在此案中，造纸厂必然会获得因伐木公司未能交付足够原木而遭受的20万美元损失的赔偿。这些应属于间接损害赔偿。造纸厂还可以获得附带损害赔偿，包括运输额外原木的25000美元和支付给经纪人的佣金5000美元——总计30000美元。然而，2000美元的律师费是不可追偿的（选项D）。因此，如果法院裁定造纸厂胜诉，应判给其23万美元的损害赔偿金（选项A和B）。

Educational objective:
When a seller breaches a contract by failing to deliver some or all of the goods, the buyer's recoverable damages include the cost of cover, incidental damages, and consequential damages—but not attorney's fees.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

U.C.C. § 2-711 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's remedies in general).

U.C.C. § 2-712 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's procurement of substitute goods).

U.C.C. § 2-715 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's incidental & consequential damages).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Remedies
损害赔偿计算表
间接额外损失
$200,000
附带经纪人费用
+ $5,000
附带运输费用
+ $25,000
排除律师咨询费
$2,000
法院判赔总额
$230,000
核心法律依据 (UCC Article 2)

本题考查买方在卖方违约（未交付货物）时的损害赔偿计算。根据《统一商法典》(UCC)，买方进行补进 (Cover) 后，可获得的赔偿包括：

1. 间接损害赔偿 (Consequential Damages)
UCC § 2-715(2)

包括因买方特殊情况导致的任何损失，前提是卖方在签约时有理由知晓该情况，且买方无法通过补进合理避免。题目明确指出造纸厂尽管努力减轻损害，仍遭受了 $200,000 的损失，这部分应予赔偿。

2. 附带损害赔偿 (Incidental Damages)
UCC § 2-715(1)

包括因违约而产生的合理费用，如检验、接收、运输货物，以及为进行补进 (Cover) 而产生的商业上合理的费用或佣金。

  • 经纪人费用 ($5,000)：为了寻找替代原木，属于合理的补进费用。
  • 运输费用 ($25,000)：运输替代原木的成本，属于合理的附带费用。
3. 律师费 (Attorney's Fees)
The "American Rule"

不可追偿！

在美国法律体系下（美国规则），除非合同有明确约定或法规特别规定，否则胜诉方不能向败诉方追讨律师费。UCC 并未规定普通违约案件可追讨律师费。因此，$2,000 的咨询费不计入赔偿。

💡 MBE 答题技巧：
在计算损害赔偿（Damages）的题目中，出题人常会列出一堆数字。请务必警惕“律师费”这一项。在 Contracts 题目中，除非题目明确说“合同规定败诉方承担律师费”，否则永远不要把律师费加进赔偿总额里。
正确答案：C ($230,000)

questions.question:
A husband and wife entered into an agreement with a contractor to construct an addition to their home. The couple agreed to pay the contractor $75,000, with $10,000 to be paid upon the signing of the contract, progress payments of $25,000 to be made when the addition was one-third and two-thirds complete, and a final payment of $15,000 when the addition was complete. Immediately after the addition was two-thirds complete, and the contractor had received the payments called for under the contract, the contractor informed the couple that it would be unable to complete the addition. At that time, the contractor had incurred costs of $45,000 out of the $60,000 in costs that the contractor had anticipated incurring to complete the addition. The couple found another contractor to complete the addition at a cost of $35,000. The couple filed a breach of contract action against the first contractor, seeking expectation damages.
How much should the couple be awarded in damages?

choices.a: $35,000, to recover the amount the couple had to pay the second contractor to finish the job.
choices.b: $20,000, to recover the total amount that the couple paid to the second contractor, less the final payment the couple would have paid to the contractor.
choices.c: $15,000, to deny the first contractor the profit it would have made had it finished the addition.
choices.d: $10,000, based on the amount paid by the couple to the first contractor, less two-thirds of the contract price.

questions.question:
A tenant rented a commercial building from a landlord and operated a business in it. The building's large front window was smashed by vandals six months before expiration of the tenant-landlord lease. The tenant, who was obligated thereunder to effect and pay for repairs in such cases, promptly contracted with a window store to replace the window for $2,000, due 30 days after satisfactory completion of the work. The landlord was then unaware of the tenant-store contract. The store was aware that the building was under lease but dealt entirely with the tenant.
Sixty days after the store's satisfactory completion of the window replacement, and prior to the expiration of the tenant's lease, the tenant ceased doing business and vacated the building. In so doing, the tenant forfeited his right to the return of a $2,000 security deposit with the landlord under the lease provisions. The deposit had been required, however, for the express purpose (as stated in the lease) of covering any damage to the leased property except ordinary wear and tear. The only such damage occurring during the tenant's occupancy was the smashed window. The window store's $2,000 bill for the window replacement is wholly unpaid.
Assuming that the window store has no remedy quasi in rem under the relevant state mechanic's lien statute, which of the following would provide the store's best chance of an effective remedy in personam against the landlord?

choices.a: An action as third-party intended beneficiary of the tenant-landlord lease.
choices.b: An action based on an implied-in-fact contract.
choices.c: An action based on promissory estoppel.
choices.d: An action in quasi-contract for the reasonable value of a benefit non-gratuitously conferred on the landlord.

一名租户向房东租用了一栋商业建筑，并在其中经营业务。在租户与房东的租约到期前六个月，该建筑的一扇大型前窗被破坏者砸碎。根据租约，租户有义务在此类情况下进行并支付维修费用，因此他立即与一家窗户店签订合同，以2000美元的价格更换窗户，款项在工程圆满完成后30天内支付。当时，房东并不知道租户与窗户店之间的合同。窗户店知道该建筑处于租赁状态，但完全是与租户打交道。

在窗户店圆满完成窗户更换工作六十天后，且在租户租约到期前，租户停止了业务并搬离了该建筑。如此一来，根据租约条款，租户丧失了向房东收回2000美元保证金的权利。然而，要求这笔保证金的明确目的（如租约中所述）是为了弥补除正常磨损外的任何对租赁财产的损害。在租户占用期间发生的唯一此类损害就是被砸碎的窗户。窗户店更换窗户的2000美元账单完全未被支付。

假设根据相关州的技工留置权法规，窗户店没有准对物之诉的救济方式，那么以下哪项能为窗户店提供对房东进行有效的对人之诉救济的最佳机会？
options:
A. An action as third-party intended beneficiary of the tenant-landlord lease.
作为租户-房东租约的第三方意定受益人提起诉讼。

B. An action based on an implied-in-fact contract.
基于事实默示合同提起的诉讼。

C. An action based on promissory estoppel.
基于允诺禁反言提起的诉讼。

D. An action in quasi-contract for the reasonable value of a benefit non-gratuitously conferred on the landlord.
为向房东非无偿提供的利益的合理价值而提起的准合同之诉。
data.explanation:
Implied contracts


Implied-in-factFormed when party manifests assent by conduct rather than spoken or written words Eg, contractor mistakenly paves driveway & owner does not object
Implied-in-law †

("quasi")		Constructed by court to prevent unjust enrichment when party receives benefit from another who reasonably expects compensation Eg, physician treats unconscious person
†Implied-in-law contracts are not true contracts since they lack mutual assent.

An "in personam" remedy is effective against a particular defendant, as opposed to the world at large. In personam remedies are available in most causes of action, including quasi-contract. A plaintiff can recover in quasi-contract - despite having no contractual relationship with the defendant - if the plaintiff conferred a non-gratuitous benefit on the defendant that resulted in unjust enrichment.

Here, the tenant hired the window store to replace a broken window for $2,000 but failed to pay the bill. Although the landlord had no contractual relationship with the window store, he benefited from the window replacement in his building. This unjustly enriched the landlord since the tenant had forfeited his $2,000 security deposit and there was no other damage during the tenant's lease for which the landlord had to use the deposit. Therefore, quasi-contract provides the store's best chance for an effective in personam remedy against the landlord.

(Choice A) An intended third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to the contract whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly. Intended beneficiaries have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them. But here, the landlord and tenant had no intent to benefit the window store when they entered the lease agreement.

(Choice B) Implied-in-fact contracts are formed when the parties manifest assent by conduct rather than spoken or written words. But the landlord and window store could not have formed one here since the store dealt entirely with the tenant.

(Choice C) Promissory estoppel provides a basis for a party to enforce a promise on which it relied when no valid contract was formed. But promissory estoppel would be ineffective here since the landlord never promised to pay the window store's bill.

Educational objective: A plaintiff can recover under a quasi-contract theory - despite having no contractual relationship with the defendant - if the plaintiff conferred a non-gratuitous benefit on the defendant that resulted in unjust enrichment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 6%，C选项 5%，D选项 73%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

默示合同


事实默示合同当一方当事人通过行为而非口头或书面文字表示同意时成立。例如，承包商错误地铺设了车道，而业主没有提出异议。
法律默示合同 †

（“准合同”）		由法院构建，旨在防止一方当事人从另一方获得利益而产生不当得利，而另一方合理期望得到补偿。例如，医生治疗昏迷者。
†法律默示合同并非真正的合同，因为它们缺乏双方合意。

“对人之诉”救济是针对特定被告有效，而非针对全世界。对人之诉的救济适用于大多数诉因，包括准合同。原告可以根据准合同获得赔偿——尽管与被告没有合同关系——如果原告向被告授予了非无偿的利益，从而导致了不当得利。

在本案中，租户雇佣窗户店以2000美元的价格更换破损的窗户，但未能支付账单。尽管房东与窗户店没有合同关系，但他从其建筑物中的窗户更换中获益。这使得房东不当得利，因为租户已经丧失了他2000美元的保证金，并且在租户的租期内没有其他损害需要房东使用这笔保证金。因此，准合同为窗户店提供了对房东进行有效对人之诉救济的最佳机会。

(选项 A) 意定第三方受益人是指合同订立双方意图直接使其受益的合同外第三方。意定受益人拥有合同权利，并可以提起诉讼以强制执行。但在本案中，房东和租户在签订租赁协议时并无意图使窗户店受益。

(选项 B) 事实默示合同是在双方通过行为而非口头或书面文字表示同意时成立的。但在此案中，房东和窗户店不可能形成事实默示合同，因为窗户店完全是与租户打交道。

(选项 C) 允诺禁反言为一方当事人在没有有效合同形成时，强制执行其所依赖的允诺提供了依据。但允诺禁反言在此处无效，因为房东从未承诺支付窗户店的账单。

教学目标：原告可以根据准合同理论获得赔偿——尽管与被告没有合同关系——如果原告向被告授予了非无偿的利益，从而导致了不当得利。

References

Restatement (Third) of Restitution and Unjust Enrichment § 1 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (explaining that a party is subject to liability for restitution when he/she is unjustly enriched at the expense of another).

MBE 考点解析

Remedies & Contracts

核心考点：准合同与不当得利

Quasi-Contract Unjust Enrichment

本题考察的是当双方没有正式合同关系时，法律如何通过“法律默示合同”（Implied-in-law Contract）来防止一方不公平地获利。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

准合同 (Quasi-Contract) 并非真正的合同，而是一种法律拟制（Legal Fiction）。法院使用这一工具来提供对人救济 (in personam remedy)，目的是防止不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。

1. 利益的授予 (Benefit Conferred):
窗户店 (Store) 修复了窗户，房东 (Landlord) 获得了一个完好的建筑物。这是一种非无偿的利益 (Non-gratuitous benefit)。
2. 关键事实 - 保证金 (The Security Deposit):
这是本题最关键的转折点。通常情况下，房东不对租户订购的装修负责。但是，房东扣留了租户的 $2,000 保证金。
  • 保证金的用途明确为“修复损坏”。
  • 唯一的损坏就是窗户。
  • 房东既拿到了修好的窗户，又拿到了修窗户的钱。
3. 结论 (Conclusion):
如果允许房东保留窗户且不支付费用，同时还没收了本应用于支付该费用的保证金，房东就构成了不当得利。因此，法院会构建一个准合同，强制房东向窗户店支付费用的合理价值。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A：第三方意定受益人 (Third-party Beneficiary)

错误原因：缺乏意图 (Intent)。
要成为意定受益人，原始合同双方（房东和租户）在签订租约时必须有意图让窗户店受益。显然，他们在签租约时根本不知道窗户会碎，更没有意图让未来的维修店受益。

选项 B：事实默示合同 (Implied-in-fact Contract)

错误原因：缺乏行为合意 (Mutual Assent by Conduct)。
事实默示合同是真正的合同，需要双方通过行为达成一致。本案中，房东甚至不知道合同的存在，完全没有参与，因此不存在合意。

选项 C：允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel)

错误原因：缺乏承诺 (No Promise)。
此原则要求被告做出了一个承诺，且原告合理信赖了该承诺。房东从未对窗户店做出任何承诺，窗户店是基于与租户的合同行事。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Remedies 问题时，如果原告无法基于合同（Contract）或侵权（Tort）索赔，请立即检查 Restitution（返还请求权） 或 Quasi-Contract（准合同）。

寻找“双重获利”或“明显不公”的事实模式。如果被告在没有正当理由的情况下保留了利益且未付款，答案通常指向“不当得利”。

On June 15, a teacher accepted a contract for a one-year position teaching math at a public high school at a salary of $50,000, starting in September.
On June 22, the school district informed the teacher that, due to a change in its planned math curriculum, the high school no longer needed a full-time math teacher. The school district offered instead to employ the teacher as a part-time academic counselor at a salary of $20,000, starting in September. The teacher refused the school district's offer.
On June 29, the teacher was offered a one-year position to teach math at a nearby private academy for $47,000, starting in September. The teacher, however, decided to spend the year completing work on a graduate degree in mathematics and declined the academy's offer.
If the teacher sues the school district for breach of contract, what is her most likely recovery?

choices.a: $3,000, the full contract amount less the amount the teacher could have earned in the teaching position at the academy.
choices.b: $30,000, the full contract amount less the amount the teacher could have earned in the counselor position offered by the school district.
choices.c: $50,000, the full contract amount.
choices.d: Nothing, because the school district notified the teacher of its decision before the teacher had acted in substantial reliance on the contract.

Q81194

On June 15, a teacher accepted a contract for a one-year position teaching math at a public high school at a salary of $50,000, starting in September.

On June 22, the school district informed the teacher that, due to a change in its planned math curriculum, the high school no longer needed a full- time math teacher. The school district offered instead to employ the teacher as a part-time academic counselor at a salary of $20,000, starting in September. The teacher refused the school district's offer.

On June 29, the teacher was offered a one-year position to teach math at a nearby private academy for $47,000, starting in September. The teacher, however, decided to spend the year completing work on a graduate degree in mathematics and declined the academy's offer.

If the teacher sues the school district for breach of contract, what is her most likely recovery?

6月15日，一名教师接受了一份合同，将在某公立高中担任为期一年的数学教师，年薪为50,000美元，于9月开始。

6月22日，学区通知该教师，由于计划中的数学课程有所变动，该高中不再需要全职数学教师。学区转而提出要约，聘用该教师为兼职学术顾问，年薪为20,000美元，于9月开始。该教师拒绝了学区的要约。

6月29日，附近一所私立学院向该教师提供了一个为期一年的数学教学职位要约，年薪为47,000美元，于9月开始。然而，该教师决定用这一年时间完成其数学研究生学位，并拒绝了该学院的要约。

如果该教师以违约为由起诉学区，她最可能获得的赔偿是多少？
options:
A. $3,000, the full contract amount less the amount the teacher could have earned in the teaching position at the academy.
3,000美元，即合同总金额减去该教师本可以在学院的教学职位上获得的收入。

B. $30,000, the full contract amount less the amount the teacher could have earned in the counselor position offered by the school district.
30,000美元，即合同总金额减去该教师本可以在学区提供的顾问职位上获得的收入。

C. $50,000, the full contract amount.
50,000美元，即合同总金额。

D. Nothing, because the school district notified the teacher of its decision before the teacher had acted in substantial reliance on the contract.
无赔偿，因为学区在教师对合同产生实质性信赖并采取行动之前已通知其决定。
data.explanation:
Purpose of compensatory damages


Primary
(expectation measure)		Place nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been performed. Expectation measure includes:
  • Expectation damages
  • Incidental damages
  • Consequential damages
Fallback
(reliance measure)		When expectation measure too speculative, place nonbreaching party in same position as if no contract had been formed. Reliance measure includes:
  • Reliance damages
  • Liquidated damages
  • Restitution
The primary purpose of compensatory damages is to place the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been performed (ie, give that party the "benefit of the bargain"). Therefore, when an employer breaches an employment agreement, the employee can recover the unpaid salary under the contract. But to avoid a reduction in the total damages award, the employee must make reasonable efforts to mitigate losses by securing comparable employment.†

Here, the school district breached the contract by firing the teacher before her employment began. As a result, the teacher suffered damages of $50,000 - the amount of her unpaid salary. But since the teacher failed to mitigate her losses by accepting a comparable teaching position at a nearby private academy, her total damages award will be reduced by the $47,000 salary she could have earned at that job. Therefore, the teacher is entitled to recover $3,000 ($50,000 - $47,000 = $3,000) from the school district (Choice C).

†Recovery will not be reduced if the employee made reasonable but unsuccessful efforts to secure comparable employment.

(Choice B) It is unlikely that a court would consider the part-time counseling position to be comparable employment, so the teacher's damages of $50,000 should not be reduced by the $20,000 she could have earned in that position. As a result, $30,000 is not the appropriate measure of recovery.

(Choice D) Arguably, the teacher had acted in substantial reliance on the contract by discontinuing her search for employment. But reliance is irrelevant to the teacher's right to recover damages under the teaching contract.

Educational objective: Following an employer's breach of an employment contract, the employee is expected to make reasonable efforts to mitigate losses by securing comparable employment. Failure to do so results in a reduced recovery from the employer (ie, unpaid salary minus loss that could have been avoided by accepting comparable employment).

选项正确率统计：A选项 77%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 5%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

补偿性损害赔偿的目的


主要原则
(预期利益赔偿标准)		将非违约方置于合同如同已被履行的相同境地。预期利益赔偿标准包括：
  • 预期利益损害赔偿
  • 附带损害赔偿
  • 间接损害赔偿
备用原则
(信赖利益赔偿标准)		当预期利益赔偿标准过于不确定时，将非违约方置于如同合同未曾订立的相同境地。信赖利益赔偿标准包括：
  • 信赖利益损害赔偿
  • 约定违约金
  • 恢复原状
补偿性损害赔偿的主要目的是将非违约方置于合同如同已被履行的相同境地（即，给予该方“交易的利益”）。因此，当雇主违反雇佣协议时，雇员可以追偿合同项下的未付薪水。但是，为了避免总损害赔偿额被减少，雇员必须做出合理努力，通过获得可比的雇佣来减损。†

在本案中，学区在雇佣开始前解雇了教师，从而违反了合同。因此，该教师遭受了50,000美元的损害——即她未付薪水的金额。但由于该教师未能通过接受附近私立学院提供的可比的教学职位来减轻其损失，她的总损害赔偿额将被减去她本可以在该工作中获得的47,000美元薪水。因此，该教师有权向学区追偿3,000美元（50,000美元 - 47,000美元 = 3,000美元）（选项A）。

†如果雇员做出了合理但未成功的努力来获得可比的雇佣，则赔偿额不会被减少。

（选项B） 法院不太可能将兼职顾问职位视为可比的雇佣，因此教师的50,000美元损害赔偿不应减去她本可以在该职位上获得的20,000美元。因此，30,000美元不是适当的赔偿标准。

（选项D） 可以说，该教师因终止求职而已经对合同产生了实质性信赖并采取了行动。但信赖与教师根据教学合同获得损害赔偿的权利无关。

教学目标：在雇主违反雇佣合同后，雇员应做出合理努力，通过获得可比的雇佣来减轻损失。未能这样做将导致从雇主处获得的赔偿减少（即，未付薪水减去因接受可比雇佣本可避免的损失）。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies & Mitigation
⚖️ 核心法律规则 当雇主违反雇佣合同时，雇员有义务通过寻找“可比工作” (Comparable Employment) 来减轻损失 (Mitigate Damages)。

赔偿金额 = 合同约定薪资 - 雇员已经赚取或本可以通过合理努力赚取的金额。

本题的正确答案是 A。以下是详细的法律推理步骤：

1确定违约事实

学区 (School District) 在合同履行前通知教师不再需要她，这构成了预期违约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。教师有权获得损害赔偿。

2评估减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate)

根据普通法，非违约方不能通过坐视不管来扩大损失。教师必须尽合理努力寻找实质上相似 (Substantially Similar) 的工作。

关键判断标准：工作性质、地点、职位等级是否相当。

3分析两个工作机会
  • ❌ 兼职学术顾问 ($20k)：
    这不是可比工作。它是兼职 (Part-time) 且职位性质不同 (Counselor vs. Teacher)。教师没有义务接受这份工作来减损，拒绝它不会减少她的赔偿金。
  • ✅ 私立学院数学教师 ($47k)：
    这是可比工作。同样是教数学，地点在附近，性质相似。虽然是私立学校且工资略低，但在法律上通常被视为“可比”。
4计算最终赔偿

教师拒绝了私立学院的工作去读研，这是她个人的选择，但在法律上视为未能履行减损义务 (Failure to Mitigate)。

法院会从总赔偿中扣除她本可以赚到的钱。

$50,000 (原合同)
- $47,000 (本可赚取的收入)
------------------
= $3,000 (最终赔偿)
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B ($30,000)： 错误地扣除了顾问职位的 $20k。因为该职位不是“可比工作”，教师无义务接受，不应扣除。
  • 选项 C ($50,000)： 忽略了减损义务。如果她尽了努力但找不到工作，才能拿全额。
  • 选项 D (无赔偿)： 混淆了概念。一旦合同成立，违约即产生赔偿权利，不需要证明“信赖” (Reliance)。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在雇佣合同违约题中，注意区分“不同或低级” (Different or Inferior) 的工作。

如果原告是电影明星，被告违约后提供了一个西部片配角（原合同是歌舞片主角），原告可以拒绝且不影响赔偿（参考著名判例 Parker v. Twentieth Century-Fox）。但如果工作性质基本一致（如本题中的公立 vs 私立数学老师），则必须接受或被扣除相应金额。

questions.question:
On April 1, a mechanic contracted to repair a toy company's molding machine and to complete the job by April 6. On April 2, the toy company contracted to manufacture and deliver specified toys to a customer on April 15. The toy company knew that it would have to use the machine then under repair to perform this contract. Because the customer's order was for a weeklong toy conference, the customer and the toy company included in their contract a liquidated damages clause, providing that the toy company would pay $5,000 for each day's delay in delivery after April 15.
The mechanic was inexcusably five days late in repairing the machine, and, as a result, the toy company was five days late in delivering the toys to the customer. The toy company paid $25,000 to the customer as liquidated damages and now sues the mechanic for $25,000. Both the mechanic and the toy company knew when making their contract on April 1 that, under ordinary circumstances, the toy company would sustain little or no damages of any kind as a result of a five-day delay in the machine repair.
Assuming that the $5,000 liquidated damages clause in the customer's contract is valid, which of the following arguments will serve as the mechanic's best defense to the toy company's action?

choices.a: By entering into the contract with the customer while knowing that its molding machine was being repaired, the toy company assumed the risk of any delay loss to the customer.
choices.b: In all probability, the liquidated damages paid by the toy company to the customer are not the same amount as the actual damages sustained by the customer in consequence of the late delivery of the toys.
choices.c: The mechanic had no reason to foresee on April 1 that the toy company would suffer consequential damages in the amount of $25,000.
choices.d: Time was not of the essence in the contract between the mechanic and the toy company.

Assuming that the $5,000 liquidated damages clause in the customer's contract is valid, which of the following arguments will serve as the mechanic's best defense to the toy company's action?

4月1日，一名技工与一家玩具公司签订合同，修理该公司的模塑机，并于4月6日前完成工作。4月2日，该玩具公司与一名客户签订合同，生产并于4月15日向其交付指定玩具。玩具公司知道，它必须使用当时正在维修的机器来履行这份合同。由于客户的订单是为了一个为期一周的玩具会议，客户和玩具公司在他们的合同中加入了一项违约金条款，规定在4月15日之后，每延迟交付一天，玩具公司将支付5000美元。

该技工在维修机器方面无故迟延了五天，结果，玩具公司向客户交付玩具也迟延了五天。玩具公司向客户支付了25,000美元作为违约金，现在起诉该技工，要求其赔偿25,000美元。技工和玩具公司在4月1日签订合同时都知道，在通常情况下，因机器维修延迟五天，玩具公司几乎不会遭受任何形式的损害。

假设客户合同中5000美元的违约金条款有效，下列哪项主张将成为技工对玩具公司诉讼的最佳抗辩理由？
options:
A. By entering into the contract with the customer while knowing that its molding machine was being repaired, the toy company assumed the risk of any delay loss to the customer.
玩具公司在明知其模塑机正在维修的情况下与客户签订合同，从而承担了对客户造成任何延迟损失的风险。

B. In all probability, the liquidated damages paid by the toy company to the customer are not the same amount as the actual damages sustained by the customer in consequence of the late delivery of the toys.
玩具公司向客户支付的违约金，很可能与客户因玩具延迟交付而遭受的实际损失金额不同。

C. The mechanic had no reason to foresee on April 1 that the toy company would suffer consequential damages in the amount of $25,000.
技工在4月1日没有理由预见到玩具公司会遭受数额为25,000美元的间接损失。

D. Time was not of the essence in the contract between the mechanic and the toy company.
在技工与玩具公司的合同中，时间并非关键要素。
data.explanation:
Consequential damages


Damages for losses stemming from nonbreaching party's special circumstances if breaching party:
  • knew of those special circumstances
  • OR
  • could have reasonably foreseen harm caused by breach
After establishing a breach-of-contract claim, the nonbreaching party is entitled to recover compensatory damages to compensate for actual economic losses. Compensatory damages include:
  • expectation damages - the lost value of the breaching party's performance and
  • consequential damages - losses that arise from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances (eg, an unrelated contract) that were reasonably foreseeable to the breaching party when his/her contract was formed.


Here, the mechanic was inexcusably five days late in repairing the toy company's molding machine. As a result, the company lost $25,000 under its unrelated contract with the customer (special circumstance) formed on April 2. But when the mechanic contracted with the company on April 1, he knew that the company ordinarily would sustain little or no damages from a five-day delay. Therefore, the mechanic's best defense to the company's action is that on April 1 he had no reason to foresee the company's consequential damages.

(Choice A) Consequential damages are unavailable if the nonbreaching party assumed the risk of that loss when the contract was formed. This is true even when the loss was foreseeable to the breaching party. But here, the toy company's allocation of risk with the customer has no bearing on its allocation of risk with the mechanic .

(Choice B) A liquidated damages clause is invalid if the liquidated amount was unreasonable in relation to the damages that might be sustained. But since liquidated damages are designed to protect the parties when the actual damages are uncertain, liquidated damages can differ from the actual damages sustained.

(Choice D) To determine whether a party's late performance is a material breach, courts consider all the circumstances, including whether the contract stated that time was of the essence. But even if this language is missing (as seen here), a party's late performance can still be a material breach.

Educational objective: Compensatory damages for breach include (1) expectation damages for the lost value of the breaching party's performance and (2) consequential damages for losses that arise from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances that were reasonably foreseeable to the breaching party when the contract was formed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 2%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

间接损失


因非违约方的特殊情况所导致的损失的损害赔偿，条件是违约方：
  • 知晓该等特殊情况
  • 或
  • 本可以合理预见到违约所造成的损害
在违约主张成立后，非违约方有权获得补偿性损害赔偿，以弥补实际经济损失。补偿性损害赔偿包括：
  • 预期损害赔偿 - 违约方未履行部分的价值损失 以及
  • 间接损失 - 因非违约方的特殊情况（例如，一份不相关的合同）而产生，且在违约方签订合同时是其可合理预见的损失。


在本案中，技工在维修玩具公司的模塑机方面无故迟延了五天。结果，公司根据其于4月2日与客户签订的不相关合同（特殊情况）损失了25,000美元。但是，当技工于4月1日与公司签订合同时，他知道公司在通常情况下因五天的延迟几乎不会遭受任何损害。因此，技工对公司诉讼的最佳抗辩理由是，他在4月1日没有理由预见到公司的间接损失。

(选项A) 如果非违约方在合同成立时承担了该损失的风险，则间接损失不可获得赔偿。即使违约方可预见到该损失，此规则依然适用。但在本案中，玩具公司与客户之间的风险分配，与其和技工之间的风险分配无关。

(选项B) 如果约定的违约金数额相对于可能遭受的损失而言不合理，则该违约金条款无效。但由于违约金旨在当实际损失不确定时保护各方当事人，因此违约金可以与所遭受的实际损失不同。

(选项D) 为确定一方的延迟履行是否构成重大违约，法院会考虑所有情况，包括合同是否规定时间是关键要素。但即使没有这样的表述（如此处所示），一方的延迟履行仍可能构成重大违约。

教学目的：违约的补偿性损害赔偿包括（1）因违约方未履行部分的价值损失而产生的预期损害赔偿，以及（2）因非违约方的特殊情况而产生，且在违约方签订合同时是其可合理预见的损失而产生的间接损失。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that consequential damages must be foreseeable).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
⚖️ 核心考点：间接损失 (Consequential Damages)

根据普通法经典判例 Hadley v. Baxendale，非违约方要获得间接损失（即因特殊情况导致的损失）的赔偿，必须证明：

在合同订立时 (at the time of contracting)，违约方已经知晓或应当合理预见到这些特殊情况会导致此类损失。

📅 关键时间线分析
4月1日
技工与玩具公司签订维修合同。
此时双方均认为：延迟5天通常不会造成损失。
4月2日
玩具公司与客户签订销售合同。
包含高额违约金条款（特殊情况）。
4月6日
技工原本应完成工作的日期。

关键逻辑： 技工的责任范围被锁定在4月1日。因为导致高额损失的“特殊情况”（4月2日的合同）在4月1日时尚未存在，技工不可能预见到这笔损失。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 C)
正确理由

不可预见性 (Unforeseeability)：

题目明确指出，在4月1日签订合同时，技工没有理由预见到玩具公司会遭受25,000美元的间接损失。事实上，题目甚至说双方当时都知道“通常情况下不会有损失”。

由于这笔损失源于技工无法预见的特殊情况（Special Circumstances），根据合同法规则，这笔间接损失不能由技工承担。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A (风险承担)

错误： 玩具公司与客户之间的风险分配（Assumption of Risk）不影响技工的责任。技工免责的原因不是因为玩具公司承担了风险，而是因为技工自己无法预见损失。

选项 B (违约金数额)

错误： 玩具公司支付给客户的违约金是否合理，是玩具公司与客户之间的问题。即使该违约金是合理的，只要技工在签约时无法预见，技工就不需要赔偿。

选项 D (时间要素)

错误： 即使合同中没有“时间是关键要素” (Time is of the essence) 条款，延迟履行仍然构成违约 (Breach)。这只能决定违约是“重大”还是“轻微”，并不改变损害赔偿的可预见性规则。

💡 MBE 备考小贴士：
在处理损害赔偿 (Remedies) 问题时，一定要区分：
  • 一般损害 (General Damages)： 自然产生的，无需特殊通知（如维修的市场价差）。
  • 间接损害 (Consequential Damages)： 因特殊情况产生的。必须检查“签约时”违约方是否知情。如果特殊情况发生在签约后，违约方通常免责。

A builder contracted in writing to construct a small greenhouse on a homeowner's property for $20,000, payable upon completion. After the builder spent $9,000 framing the greenhouse and an additional $1,000 for materials not yet incorporated into the greenhouse, the homeowner wrongfully ordered the builder to stop work.
The builder then resold the unused materials that he had already purchased for the greenhouse to another contractor for $1,000. At the time the homeowner stopped the work, it would have cost the builder an additional $5,000 to complete the project. The partially built greenhouse increased the value of the homeowner's property by $3,000.
In a suit by the builder against the homeowner, how much is the builder likely to recover?

choices.a: $3,000, the increase in the value of the homeowner's property.
choices.b: $10,000, the total cost expended by the builder at the time of the breach.
choices.c: $14,000, the total cost expended by the builder ($10,000) plus the builder's expected profit ($5,000), minus the loss avoided by the resale of the unused materials ($1,000).
choices.d: $15,000, the contract price ($20,000) minus the costs saved by the breach ($5,000).

Q81820 A builder contracted in writing to construct a small greenhouse on a homeowner's property for $20,000, payable upon completion. After the builder spent $9,000 framing the greenhouse and an additional $1,000 for materials not yet incorporated into the greenhouse, the homeowner wrongfully ordered the builder to stop work.

The builder then resold the unused materials that he had already purchased for the greenhouse to another contractor for $1,000. At the time the homeowner stopped the work, it would have cost the builder an additional $5,000 to complete the project. The partially built greenhouse increased the value of the homeowner's property by $3,000.

In a suit by the builder against the homeowner, how much is the builder likely to recover? 一名建筑商签订书面合同，为一位房主在其地产上建造一个小温室，合同价为20,000美元，完工后支付。建筑商花费9,000美元搭建温室框架，并额外花费1,000美元购买了尚未并入温室的材料后，房主不当命令建筑商停止工作。

随后，建筑商将已为该温室购买的未使用材料以1,000美元的价格转售给另一位承包商。在房主叫停工作时，建筑商要完成该项目还需要额外花费5,000美元。部分建成的温室使房主的财产价值增加了3,000美元。

在建筑商对房主提起的诉讼中，建筑商可能获得多少赔偿？
options:
A. A. $3,000, the increase in the value of the homeowner's property.
A. 3,000美元，即房主财产的增值额。

B. B. $10,000, the total cost expended by the builder at the time of the breach.
B. 10,000美元，即建筑商在违约时支出的总成本。

C. C. $14,000, the total cost expended by the builder ($10,000) plus the builder's expected profit ($5,000), minus the loss avoided by the resale of the unused materials ($1,000).
C. 14,000美元，即建筑商支出的总成本（10,000美元）加上建筑商的预期利润（5,000美元），再减去因转售未使用材料而避免的损失（1,000美元）。

D. D. $15,000, the contract price ($20,000) minus the costs saved by the breach ($5,000).
D. 15,000美元，即合同价格（20,000美元）减去因违约而节省的成本（5,000美元）。

Contract damages are meant to compensate the nonbreaching party by putting the party in the same position as if the contract had been performed. For example, if an owner breaches a construction contract during construction, the builder can recover any costs incurred up to that point plus the profits it would have earned. However, any costs the builder avoided (eg, by mitigation) will be subtracted from the total damages award.

Here, the builder had incurred $10,000 in costs ($9,000 completed frame + $1,000 in additional materials) at the time of breach. The builder lost an expected profit of $5,000 ($20,000 contract price – $10,000 costs – $5,000 cost to complete the greenhouse). But he was able to mitigate some of those costs by selling the additional materials for $1,000. Therefore, the builder is likely to recover $14,000, the total cost he expended ($10,000) plus his expected profit ($5,000), minus the loss avoided by the resale of the unused materials ($1,000) (Choices B & D).

(Choice A) The builder is entitled to seek restitution for the value of the benefit conferred on the homeowner (ie, the $3,000 increase in property value) in lieu of the standard measure of damages. But the builder is unlikely to seek restitution since he can recover $14,000 under the contract instead.

Educational objective: When an owner breaches a construction contract during construction, the builder is entitled to lost profits plus costs incurred. But any costs avoided (eg, by mitigation) will be subtracted from the total damages award.

合同价格
合同损害赔偿旨在通过使未违约方处于合同如同被履行一样的地位来补偿该方。例如，如果业主在施工期间违反建筑合同，建筑商可以追偿截至该时间点已发生的所有成本，外加其本应赚取的利润。但是，建筑商避免的任何成本（例如，通过减损）将从损害赔偿总额中扣除。

在本案中，建筑商在违约时已产生10,000美元的成本（9,000美元的已完成框架 + 1,000美元的额外材料）。建筑商损失了5,000美元的预期利润（20,000美元的合同价格 – 10,000美元的成本 – 5,000美元的温室完工成本）。但他通过以1,000美元的价格出售额外材料，得以减轻部分损失。因此，建筑商很可能获得14,000美元的赔偿，即他支出的总成本（10,000美元）加上他的预期利润（5,000美元），再减去因转售未使用材料而避免的损失（1,000美元）（选项B和D）。

(选项A) 建筑商有权就给予房主的利益价值（即3,000美元的财产增值）寻求返还，以代替标准的损害赔偿计算方法。但建筑商不太可能寻求返还，因为他可以根据合同获得14,000美元的赔偿。

教学目的： 当业主在施工期间违反建筑合同时，建筑商有权获得损失的利润加上已产生的成本。但任何避免的成本（例如，通过减损）都将从损害赔偿总额中扣除。

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 344 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (purposes of remedies).
Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 347 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (measure of damages in general).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Construction Damages

核心考点：预期利益

Expectation Damages

在合同法中，当一方违约时，法院通常会判给非违约方预期利益赔偿。其目的是让非违约方处于“仿佛合同已被完全履行”的状态。

对于建筑合同（Construction Contracts），当业主（Owner）在施工中途违约时，建筑商（Builder）的赔偿计算公式通常有两种表达方式，结果是一致的。

本题解题逻辑 (选项 C)

本题采用了“成本 + 利润”的计算路径。这是MBE中非常经典的考法。

第一步：计算预期总利润

合同总价 (Contract Price) $20,000
(-) 已发生成本 $10,000
(-) 完工尚需成本 $5,000
= 预期净利润 (Profit) $5,000

第二步：计算赔偿金

赔偿金 = 已发生成本 + 预期利润 - 减损收益
已发生成本 (Costs Incurred) $10,000
(+) 预期利润 (Expected Profit) $5,000
(-) 材料转售 (Mitigation) -$1,000
= 最终赔偿 (Total Recovery) $14,000

注意：这里的 $10,000 成本包含了 $9,000 的人工框架和 $1,000 的材料。虽然材料被卖掉了，但它首先是作为成本支出的。为了避免双重计算，我们在最后减去卖材料收回的 $1,000。

另一种常用算法 (验证)

你也可以使用“合同价减去节省的开支”来计算，结果必须相同。

赔偿金 = 合同价 - 避免的成本 - 避免的损失
合同价 $20,000
(-) 完工尚需成本 (Cost to complete) -$5,000
(-) 转售材料所得 (Loss avoided) -$1,000
= 最终赔偿 $14,000

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A ($3,000)

这是不当得利返还 (Restitution) 的计算方式（基于房主获得的增值）。虽然建筑商可以选择起诉要求 Restitution，但在本案中，合同预期的赔偿金 ($14,000) 远高于 Restitution ($3,000)，理性的原告会选择前者。

选项 B ($10,000)

这仅是信赖利益 (Reliance Damages)。它只补偿了成本，忽略了建筑商本应赚取的 $5,000 利润。除非利润无法确定（例如亏本生意），否则应包含利润。

选项 D ($15,000)

这个选项计算了“合同价 - 完工成本” ($20k - $5k)，但忘记了减去减损收益 (Mitigation)。建筑商通过转卖材料收回了 $1,000，如果不扣除这笔钱，建筑商就获得了双重收益（Overcompensation），这是合同法不允许的。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到建筑合同违约计算题：

  1. 首先确定是谁违约（本题是业主）。
  2. 确定目标是Expectation Damages。
  3. 寻找是否有Mitigation（如转卖材料）。
  4. 记住公式：(已花成本 + 预期利润) - 减损。
  5. 千万不要忘记扣除通过 Mitigation 赚回来的钱！

On November 15, a carpenter in a signed writing contracted with a homeowner for an agreed price to personally remodel the homeowner's kitchen according to specifications provided by the homeowner, and to start work on December 1. The carpenter agreed to provide all materials for the job in addition to all of the labor required.
On November 26, the carpenter without legal excuse repudiated the contract. After a reasonable and prolonged effort, the homeowner could not find anyone to remodel his kitchen for a price approximating the price agreed to by the carpenter. One year later, the homeowner brings an action for specific performance against the carpenter.
Which of the following will provide the carpenter with the best defense?

choices.a: An action for equitable relief not brought within a reasonable time is barred by laches.
choices.b: Specific performance is generally not available as a remedy in the case of an anticipatory repudiation.
choices.c: Specific performance is not available as a remedy to enforce a contractual duty to perform personal services.
choices.d: Specific performance is not available as a remedy where even nominal damages could have been recovered as a remedy at law.

11月15日，一名木匠与一名房主签订书面合同，约定以商定价格，按照房主提供的规格亲自为其改造厨房，并于12月1日开工。该木匠同意提供工作所需的所有材料及劳务。

11月26日，该木匠在没有合法理由的情况下预期违约，拒绝履行合同。经过合理且长时间的努力，房主未能找到任何愿意以与该木匠约定价格相近的价格来改造其厨房的人。一年后，房主对该木匠提起了强制履行之诉。

以下哪项将为该木匠提供最佳抗辩理由？
options:
A. An action for equitable relief not brought within a reasonable time is barred by laches.
未在合理时间内提起的衡平法救济之诉，将因懈怠原则（laches）而被禁止。

B. Specific performance is generally not available as a remedy in the case of an anticipatory repudiation.
在预期违约的情况下，强制履行通常不作为一种救济措施。

C. Specific performance is not available as a remedy to enforce a contractual duty to perform personal services.
强制履行不适用于强制执行提供个人服务的合同义务。

D. Specific performance is not available as a remedy where even nominal damages could have been recovered as a remedy at law.
在法律上即便只能获得象征性损害赔偿的情况下，强制履行也不作为一种救济措施。
data.explanation:
Personal-services contracts


DefinitionContract involving party's personal taste, skill, or talent - eg, entertainer, designer, lawyer, architect
Enforcement
  • Nonbreaching party entitled to compensatory damages stemming from breach
  • Specific performance not available
Specific performance is an equitable remedy whereby a court orders a breaching party to perform a contractual duty when monetary damages would be inadequate - eg, breach of contract for the sale of land. However, this remedy is not available to enforce a contractual duty to perform personal services because courts are unwilling to compel personal associations after a dispute.

Here, the contract provided that the carpenter would personally remodel the homeowner's kitchen. When the carpenter repudiated the contract, the homeowner brought an action for specific performance. Therefore, the carpenter's best defense is that this remedy is not available for breach of personal-services contracts.

(Choice A) The equitable defense of laches is commonly asserted in specific-performance actions. To prevail on this defense, the breaching party must show that the enforcing party's unreasonable delay in bringing the claim has resulted in prejudice - ie, substantially increased the cost or difficulty of performance. Here, the homeowner reasonably delayed suit while looking for a similarly priced carpenter and no prejudice to the carpenter is shown.

(Choice B) Specific performance is available as a remedy in cases of anticipatory repudiation - ie, where one contracting party unequivocally indicates prior to the time for performance that he/she will not perform.

(Choice D) Specific performance, like other equitable remedies, will not be granted where monetary damages are adequate. But nominal damages (eg, $1) alone are typically not an adequate remedy.

Educational objective: Specific performance - ie, court-ordered performance of a contractual duty - is not available as a remedy to enforce a contractual duty to perform personal services.

选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 5%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

个人服务合同


定义涉及当事方个人品味、技能或才能的合同——例如，艺人、设计师、律师、建筑师
强制执行
  • 非违约方有权获得因违约而产生的补偿性损害赔偿
  • 强制履行不适用
强制履行是一种衡平法上的救济，当金钱赔偿不足以弥补损失时——例如，违反土地买卖合同，法院可据此命令违约方履行合同义务。然而，这种救济不适用于强制执行提供个人服务的合同义务，因为法院不愿意在发生争议后强制建立个人联系。

在本案中，合同规定木匠将亲自改造房主的厨房。当木匠预期违约时，房主提起了强制履行之诉。因此，木匠的最佳抗辩理由是，强制履行这种救济不适用于违反个人服务合同的情况。

(选项A) 懈怠原则（laches）的衡平法抗辩在强制履行之诉中很常见。要使该抗辩成立，违约方必须证明，提出强制履行的一方不合理的拖延起诉已造成损害——即，已实质性地增加了履行的成本或难度。在本案中，房主在寻找价格相近的木匠期间合理地推迟了诉讼，并且没有证据表明对木匠造成了损害。

(选项B) 在预期违约的情况下——即，合同一方在履行期到来之前明确表示其将不履行合同，强制履行是一种可行的救济措施。

(选项D) 与其他衡平法救济一样，在金钱赔偿足以弥补损失的情况下，法院不会批准强制履行。但仅有象征性损害赔偿（例如1美元）通常不构成充分的救济。

教学目标：强制履行——即法院命令履行合同义务——不作为强制执行提供个人服务合同义务的一种救济措施。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 367 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that specific performance is not available to enforce personal contracts).
