Q81213

A sailor owns a boat that she charters for sport fishing at a $500 daily rate. The fee includes the use of the boat with the sailor as the captain, and one other crew member, as well as fishing tackle and bait. On May 1, a customer agreed with the sailor that the customer would have the full-day use of the boat on May 15 for himself and his family for $500. The customer paid an advance deposit of $200 and signed an agreement that the deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages in the event the customer canceled or failed to appear. At the time of contracting, the sailor told the customer to be at the dock at 5:00 a.m. on May 15. The customer and his family, however, did not show up on May 15 until noon. In the meantime, the sailor agreed at 10:00 a.m. to take a third party and her family out fishing for the rest of the day. The third party had happened to come by and inquire about the possibility of such an outing. In view of the late hour, the sailor charged the third party $400 and stayed out two hours beyond the customary return time. The customer's failure to appear until noon was due to the fact that he had been trying to charter another boat across the bay at a lower rate and had gotten lost after he was unsuccessful in getting such a charter.

Which of the following is an accurate statement concerning the legal obligations of the parties?

一名船主拥有一艘船，她以每日500美元的价格出租用于运动海钓。该费用包括船只的使用、船主担任船长、另一名船员，以及渔具和鱼饵。5月1日，一位顾客与船主约定，该顾客及其家人将于5月15日以500美元的价格全天使用该船。顾客支付了200美元的预付定金，并签署了一份协议，约定如果顾客取消或未能出现，船主可以保留该定金作为违约金。在签订合同时，船主告知顾客应于5月15日早上5点到达码头。然而，该顾客及其家人直到5月15日中午才出现。在此期间，船主于上午10点同意带第三方及其家人出海钓鱼度过当天余下的时间。该第三方是碰巧过来询问是否有此种出游的可能性。考虑到时间已晚，船主向该第三方收取了400美元，并且比通常的返航时间晚了两个小时。顾客直到中午才出现，是因为他试图在海湾对面以更低的价格租用另一艘船，但在未能租到船后迷路了。

以下哪项是关于双方当事人法律义务的准确陈述？
options:
A. The sailor can retain the $200 paid by the customer, because it would be difficult for the sailor to establish her actual damages and the sum appears to have been a reasonable forecast in light of anticipated loss of profit from the charter.
船主可以保留顾客支付的200美元，因为船主难以确定其实际损失，并且鉴于租船业务的预期利润损失，这笔金额似乎是一个合理的预估。

B. The sailor is entitled to retain only $50 (10% of the contract price) and must return $150 to the customer.
船主仅有权保留50美元（合同价格的10%），并且必须向顾客退还150美元。

C. The sailor must return $100 to the customer, because the liquidated-damage clause under the circumstances would operate as a penalty.
船主必须向顾客退还100美元，因为在这种情况下，违约金条款将构成一种惩罚。

D. The sailor must return $100 to the customer in order to avoid her own unjust enrichment at the customer's expense.
船主必须向顾客退还100美元，以避免因顾客的损失而获得不当得利。
data.explanation:
Purpose of compensatory damages


Primary
(expectation measure)		Place nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been performed Expectation measure includes:
  • Expectation damages
  • Incidental damages
  • Consequential damages
Fallback
(reliance measure)		When expectation measure too speculative, place nonbreaching party in same position as if no contract had been formed Reliance measure includes:
  • Reliance damages
  • Liquidated damages
  • Restitution
To recover damages, a party must prove the dollar amount of the damages with reasonable certainty. Where it would be difficult to establish actual damages , the parties may agree to liquidated damages - ie, a fixed measure of damages for breach set forth in the contract. However, a liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large in relation to actual or anticipated damages that it punishes the breaching party (as opposed to merely compensating the nonbreaching party).

Here, the customer contracted to use the sailor's boat for a full day for $500. The customer paid a $200 deposit, which the sailor could retain as liquidated damages if the customer canceled or failed to appear. Although the sailor ultimately collected $600 for the day ($200 retained deposit + $400 from the third party), she also stayed out two hours later than the customary return time as a result of the customer's breach. As a result, the $200 appears to have been a reasonable measure of damages, and the sailor can retain the full amount (Choice C).

(Choice B) There is no rule that, if applied, would result in the sailor retaining $50 (10% of the contract price).

(Choice D) Restitutionary damages ensure that the nonbreaching party (here, the sailor) is not unjustly enriched - ie, does not receive a benefit that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep. But here, the parties agreed to the deposit as a reasonable amount of damages in the event of the customer's breach.

Educational objective: A liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large in relation to actual or anticipated damages that it punishes the nonbreaching party.

选项正确率统计：A选项 59%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 15%，D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

补偿性损害赔偿的目的


主要赔偿
(预期利益赔偿)		使非违约方处于合同如同被履行一样的地位
预期利益赔偿包括：
  • 预期损害赔偿
  • 附带损害赔偿
  • 间接损害赔偿
次要赔偿
(信赖利益赔偿)		当预期利益赔偿的计算过于投机时，使非违约方处于如同合同未曾订立一样的地位
信赖利益赔偿包括：
  • 信赖损害赔偿
  • 违约金
  • 返还
为了获得损害赔偿，一方当事人必须以合理的确定性证明损害赔偿的美元金额。在难以确定实际损害的情况下，双方当事人可以约定违约金——即，在合同中为违约设定的固定赔偿标准。然而，如果违约金的数额相对于实际或预期的损害赔偿而言不合理地过高，以至于惩罚了违约方（而不仅仅是补偿非违约方），那么该违约金条款将作为一种惩罚而不可执行。

在本案中，顾客签约以500美元的价格全天使用船主的船只。顾客支付了200美元的定金，如果顾客取消或未能出现，船主可以将其作为违约金保留。尽管船主当天最终收取了600美元（保留的200美元定金 + 从第三方收取的400美元），但由于顾客的违约，她也比通常的返航时间晚了两个小时。因此，200美元似乎是一个合理的损害赔偿标准，船主可以保留全部金额(选项C)。

（选项B）没有任何规则在适用后会导致船主保留50美元（合同价格的10%）。

（选项D）返还性损害赔偿确保非违约方（此处为船主）不会不当得利——即，不会获得本不应赚取且保留下来会不公平的利益。但在本案中，双方当事人同意将定金作为在顾客违约情况下的一笔合理损害赔偿金。

教学目标：如果违约金条款的数额相对于实际或预期的损害赔偿而言不合理地过高，以至于惩罚了非违约方，那么该条款将作为一种惩罚而不可执行。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies / Liquidated Damages
⚖️ 核心考点：约定违约金 (Liquidated Damages)

在普通法下，合同中的违约金条款若要有效（Enforceable），必须满足以下两个条件，否则会被视为无效的惩罚性条款 (Penalty)：

  1. 难以估算：在订立合同时，实际损害赔偿金额难以确定或证明 (Difficult to estimate);
  2. 合理预估：约定的金额是对预期损失或实际损失的合理预测 (Reasonable forecast)。
案情关键点分析
  • 合同性质：游艇租赁服务。
  • 违约金条款：$200定金作为违约金。
  • 违约事实：顾客迟到导致违约。
  • 减损措施 (Mitigation)：船主找到了替代客户 ($400)，但工作时间延长了2小时。
  • 总收入：$200 (定金) + $400 (新客户) = $600。
为什么选 A？
正确答案

逻辑推演：

1. 难以估算性： 游艇租赁受天气、客源等因素影响，一旦顾客违约，船主能否找到替代客户以及具体损失多少，在签约时 (At the time of contracting) 是很难确定的。

2. 合理性： 合同总价$500，定金$200（占40%）。如果顾客不来，船主可能损失全额$500。因此，$200是对潜在损失的一个合理预估，并非天文数字。

3. 关于"不当得利"的抗辩： 虽然船主最终获得了$600（比原合同多$100），但这并不使条款失效。
首先，船主付出了额外的劳动（晚归2小时）。
其次，只要违约金条款在签约时是合理的，法院通常会执行该条款，而不再去计算具体的实际损失 (Actual Damages)。

干扰项排除
选项 B

错误理由： 这是对 UCC § 2-718(2)(b) 的错误引用或混淆。UCC规定在没有违约金条款时，卖方可扣留定金的上限是$500或合同价的20%（取较小者）。但本案有明确的违约金条款，且本案主要是服务合同，不完全适用纯货物买卖规则。

选项 C

错误理由： $200 并非“惩罚”。惩罚性条款通常是指金额与实际或预期损失完全不成比例（例如：合同价$500，违约金$5000）。本案中$200是合理的风险分配。

选项 D

错误理由： 不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment) 是一种衡平法救济，通常用于没有有效合同的情况。当双方有明确且有效的违约金条款时，该条款优先适用。船主保留定金是基于合同权利，而非不当得利。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
遇到 Liquidated Damages 的题目，首先判断该金额是否“荒谬地高”。如果金额看起来是合理的（Reasonable），且损失难以计算，法院倾向于支持该条款。一旦认定条款有效，不要再去计算实际损失（Actual Damages）来调整金额，直接执行条款约定的数额即可。

A person who knew nothing about horses inherited a thoroughbred colt whose disagreeable behavior made him a pest around the barn. The person sold the colt for $1,500 to a buyer who was an experienced racehorse-trainer and knew of the person's ignorance about horses. At the time of sale, the person said to the buyer, "I hate to say it, but this horse is bad-tempered and nothing special." Soon after the sale, the colt won three races and earned $400,000 for the buyer.
Which of the following additional facts, if established by the person, would best support his chance of obtaining rescission of the sale to the buyer?

choices.a: At a pre-sale exercise session of which the buyer knew that the person was not aware, the buyer clocked the colt in record-setting time, far surpassing any previous performance.
choices.b: At the time of the sale, the person was angry and upset over an incident in which the colt had reared and thrown a rider.
choices.c: The colt was the only thoroughbred that the person owned, and the person did not know how to evaluate young and untested racehorses.
choices.d: The person did not know until after the sale that the buyer was an experienced racehorse-trainer.

Q81216

A person who knew nothing about horses inherited a thoroughbred colt whose disagreeable behavior made him a pest around the barn. The person sold the colt for $1,500 to a buyer who was an experienced racehorse-trainer and knew of the person's ignorance about horses. At the time of sale, the person said to the buyer, "I hate to say it, but this horse is bad-tempered and nothing special." Soon after the sale, the colt won three races and earned $400,000 for the buyer.

Which of the following additional facts, if established by the person, would best support his chance of obtaining rescission of the sale to the buyer?

一个对马一无所知的人继承了一匹纯种小公马，这匹马的性情令人讨厌，在马厩里是个麻烦精。此人以1500美元的价格将这匹小公马卖给了一位买家，该买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师，并且知道此人对马一无所知。在出售时，此人对买家说：“我不想这么说，但这匹马脾气不好，没什么特别之处。”出售后不久，这匹小公马赢得了三场比赛，为买家赚取了40万美元。

如果以下哪个额外事实由此人证实，将最有力地支持他获得撤销与买家之间交易的机会？
options:
A. At a pre-sale exercise session of which the buyer knew that the person was not aware, the buyer clocked the colt in record-setting time, far surpassing any previous performance.
在一次售前训练中，买家测得这匹小公马的成绩创下纪录，远超以往任何表现，而买家知道此人对此并不知情。

B. At the time of the sale, the person was angry and upset over an incident in which the colt had reared and thrown a rider.
在出售时，此人正因小公马曾扬蹄将骑手摔下的事件而生气和沮丧。

C. The colt was the only thoroughbred that the person owned, and the person did not know how to evaluate young and untested racehorses.
这匹小公马是此人拥有的唯一一匹纯种马，且此人不知道如何评估年幼未经测试的赛马。

D. The person did not know until after the sale that the buyer was an experienced racehorse-trainer.
此人直到出售后才知道买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师。
data.explanation:
Mistake as grounds for rescission


Adversely affected party can rescind contract if:
  • mistake relates to basic assumption of contract
  • mistake materially affects agreed-upon exchange of performances
Mutual mistakeAND
  • adversely affected party did not assume risk of mistake
Unilateral mistakeIn addition to above elements for mutual mistake, either:
  • mistake makes enforcement of contract unconscionable
  • OR
  • nonmistaken party caused, or knew or should have known of, mistake
Rescission is a remedy that allows the court to cancel a contract and discharge the parties' contractual obligations. This remedy is available to a party who entered into a contract based on a unilateral mistake if:
  • the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract (eg, the person thought the colt was "nothing special" and so agreed to sell it for $1,500)
  • the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (eg, the colt was actually worth much more, as evidenced by its winning three races and earning $400,000)
  • the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake (eg, the person knew nothing about horses)
  • AND either (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.
Therefore, the fact that the buyer had clocked the colt in record-setting time at a pre-sale exercise session, of which the buyer knew that the person was not aware, would best support the person's chance of obtaining rescission.

(Choices B, C & D) None of these additional facts show that (1) enforcement of the sale would be unconscionable or (2) the buyer (nonmistaken party) caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the person's mistake. As a result, these facts do not support the person's chance of obtaining rescission of the sale to the buyer.

Educational objective: A party's unilateral mistake is grounds for rescission only if (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 10%，D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

作为撤销理由的错误


受不利影响的一方可以撤销合同，如果：
  • 错误与合同的基本假设有关
  • 错误对约定的对待给付有重大影响
双方错误并且
  • 受不利影响的一方没有承担错误的风险
单方错误除满足上述双方错误的要素外，还需满足以下任一条件：
  • 该错误导致合同的强制执行不合情理
  • 或者
  • 非错误方导致了该错误，或知道或理应知道该错误的存在
撤销是一种允许法院取消合同并解除双方合同义务的救济措施。当一方基于单方错误订立合同时，如果满足以下条件，则可以获得此项救济：
  • 该错误与合同的基本假设有关（例如，此人认为这匹小公马“没什么特别之处”，因此同意以1500美元的价格出售）
  • 该错误对约定的对待给付有重大影响（例如，这匹小公马的实际价值要高得多，其赢得三场比赛并赚取40万美元就是证明）
  • 受不利影响的一方没有承担错误的风险（例如，此人对马一无所知）
  • 并且，满足以下任一条件：（1）该错误将使合同的强制执行变得不合情理，或（2）非错误方导致了该错误，或知道或有理由知道该错误的存在。
因此，买家在一次售前训练中测得小公马的成绩创下纪录，且买家知道此人对此并不知情，这一事实将最有力地支持此人获得撤销交易的机会。

（选项B、C和D）这些额外事实均未表明（1）强制执行该交易会不合情理，或（2）买家（非错误方）导致了、或知道、或有理由知道此人的错误。因此，这些事实不支持此人获得撤销与买家之间交易的机会。

教学目的：一方的单方错误仅在以下情况下构成撤销合同的理由：（1）该错误将使合同的强制执行不合情理，或（2）非错误方导致了、或知道、或有理由知道该错误的存在。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (unilateral mistake making contract voidable).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：单方错误与合同撤销

本题考查合同法中的核心难点：单方错误 (Unilateral Mistake) 是否足以作为撤销合同 (Rescission) 的理由。

⚖️ 法律规则 (Rule of Law)
根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 153，一方因单方错误想要撤销合同，必须证明：
  1. 错误涉及合同的基本假设 (Basic Assumption)；
  2. 错误对交换价值有重大影响 (Material Effect)；
  3. 受损方未承担该错误的风险 (Did not bear the risk)；
  4. 关键要素：要么强制执行是不合情理的 (Unconscionable)，要么另一方知道或理应知道该错误。

为什么选项 A 是正确答案？

正确选项 A

案情分析：卖家认为马“没什么特别”，但买家在售前秘密测试中发现马打破了纪录，且买家知道卖家对此不知情。

法律推理：

  • 知情 (Knowledge)： 这是一个典型的单方错误案例。通常情况下，如果卖家自己对商品价值判断失误（“有眼不识泰山”），法律不会保护他。
  • 例外情况： 但是，如果非错误方 (Non-mistaken party)——即本案中的买家——知道卖家犯了错误并利用这一点，法院会允许撤销合同。
  • 决定性事实： 选项 A 提供了“确凿证据” (Smoking Gun)。买家不仅知道马的真实价值（破纪录），还明确知道卖家不知道这一事实。这满足了单方错误撤销规则中的“另一方知情”要件。

为什么其他选项不支持撤销？

❌ 选项 B (卖家当时很生气)：
卖家的情绪状态（动机）与合同是否因“错误”而可撤销无关。这不构成法律上的抗辩理由。

❌ 选项 C (卖家无知且只有这一匹马)：
这实际上对卖家不利。在合同法中，如果一方在“有意识的无知” (Conscious Ignorance) 状态下交易，通常被视为承担了错误的风险 (Assumed the risk)。除非买家知道并利用了这一点（如选项A所述），否则单纯的无知不能撤销合同。

❌ 选项 D (不知道买家是专家)：
买家的身份通常不是交易的“基本假设”。除非涉及特定的欺诈性身份隐瞒，否则不知道对方是专家并不影响合同效力。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在处理 MBE 的“错误” (Mistake) 题目时，请遵循以下逻辑链条：
1. 是双方错误还是单方错误？
2. 如果是单方错误，原则上合同有效。
3. 除非：非错误方由“捡漏”变成了“利用错误” (Taking advantage of the mistake)。
4. 寻找那个表明“买家知道卖家搞错了”的选项，这就是打破原则的关键。

questions.question:
A construction company contracted with a regional distributor to construct a warehouse and an access driveway at highway level for $500,000. Shortly after commencing work on the driveway, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock. Instead of incurring additional costs to remove the rock formation, the construction company built the access driveway over the rock with a steep grade down to the highway.
The distributor, who was out of town for several days, was unaware of this nonconformity until the driveway had been finished. As built, it is too steep to be used safely by trucks or cars, particularly in the wet or icy weather frequently occurring in the area. It would cost $30,000 to tear out and rebuild the driveway at highway level. As built, the warehouse, including the driveway, has a fair market value of $550,000. The distributor has paid $470,000 to the construction company, but refuses to pay more because of the nonconforming driveway, which the construction company has refused to tear out and rebuild.
If the construction company sues the distributor for monetary relief, what is the maximum amount the construction company is entitled to recover?

choices.a: $30,000, because the construction company substantially performed and the cost of correcting the driveway would involve economic waste.
choices.b: $30,000, because the fair market value of the warehouse and driveway "as is" exceeds the contract price by $50,000 (more than the cost of correcting the driveway).
choices.c: $30,000, minus whatever amount the construction company saved by not building the driveway at the specified level.
choices.d: Nothing, because the distributor is entitled to damages for the cost of correcting the driveway.

data.questionStem:
Q81218

A construction company contracted with a regional distributor to construct a warehouse and an access driveway at highway level for $500,000. Shortly after commencing work on the driveway, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock. Instead of incurring additional costs to remove the rock formation, the construction company built the access driveway over the rock with a steep grade down to the highway.

The distributor, who was out of town for several days, was unaware of this nonconformity until the driveway had been finished. As built, it is too steep to be used safely by trucks or cars, particularly in the wet or icy weather frequently occurring in the area. It would cost $30,000 to tear out and rebuild the driveway at highway level. As built, the warehouse, including the driveway, has a fair market value of $550,000. The distributor has paid $470,000 to the construction company, but refuses to pay more because of the nonconforming driveway, which the construction company has refused to tear out and rebuild.

If the construction company sues the distributor for monetary relief, what is the maximum amount the construction company is entitled to recover?

一家建筑公司与一家区域分销商签订合同，以50万美元的价格建造一个仓库和一条与公路路面齐平的入口车道 (access driveway)。在入口车道 (access driveway) 工程开工后不久，建筑公司意外地遇到了一大块坚固的岩石。建筑公司没有为移除岩石层而产生额外费用，而是在岩石上修建了入口车道 (access driveway)，形成了一个通往高速公路的陡坡。

分销商因出城数日，直到车道完工后才发现这一不符合同规定之处。建成后的车道坡度过陡，卡车或汽车无法安全使用，尤其是在该地区经常出现的潮湿或结冰天气下。拆除车道并重建至与公路齐平的水平将花费3万美元。建成后，包括车道在内的仓库的公平市场价值为55万美元。分销商已向建筑公司支付了47万美元，但因车道不符合同规定而拒绝支付更多款项，而建筑公司也拒绝拆除和重建该车道。

如果建筑公司就金钱救济起诉分销商，建筑公司有权获得的最高金额是多少？
options:
A. $30,000, because the construction company substantially performed and the cost of correcting the driveway would involve economic waste.
3万美元，因为建筑公司已实质性履行合同，且修正车道的成本会造成经济浪费。

B. $30,000, because the fair market value of the warehouse and driveway "as is" exceeds the contract price by $50,000 (more than the cost of correcting the driveway).
3万美元，因为仓库和车道“按现状”的公平市场价值比合同价格高出5万美元（超过了修正车道的成本）。

C. $30,000, minus whatever amount the construction company saved by not building the driveway at the specified level.
3万美元，减去建筑公司因未按规定水平建造车道而节省的任何金额。

D. Nothing, because the distributor is entitled to damages for the cost of correcting the driveway.
无，因为分销商有权就修正车道的成本获得损害赔偿。
data.explanation:
Compensatory damages for breach of construction contracts


Before construction startsDuring constructionAfter construction completed
Breach by builderN/AOwner entitled to cost of completion (owner paid)cost of completion/correction if no undue economic waste OR value of promised construction minus nonconforming construction
Breach by ownerBuilder entitled to lost profits plus costs incurred OR contract price minus cost of completionBuilder entitled to contract price (did not pay)
When a contract is breached, the nonbreaching party is entitled to recover compensatory damages. Compensatory damages can arise, for example, when a builder breaches a contract during construction (ie, nonconforming construction). In that case, the owner's damages are the cost of completing or correcting the nonconforming construction, provided that this would not involve any undue economic waste. One way to recover these damages is to deduct them from the contract price owed by the owner. Here, the $500,000 contract called for the construction of a driveway at highway level. The construction company breached that contract by building the driveway over a rock mass with a steep grade that makes the driveway unsafe. The $30,000 cost to correct the driveway is not unduly wasteful since this expense is necessary to safely access the warehouse (Choice A). And since the distributor was entitled to deduct that amount from the contract price and pay no more than $470,000, the construction company can recover nothing.

(Choice B) Compensatory damages attempt to put the nonbreaching party (eg, the distributor) in the same position as if the contract had been performed as promised. Therefore, the distributor was entitled to deduct his damages for the nonconforming driveway even though the value of the warehouse exceeds the contract price by a greater amount than the cost of correcting the driveway.

(Choice C) If the owner breaches a construction contract prior to completion, the builder is entitled to recover the contract price minus whatever amount the builder saved by not having to complete the construction (ie, the cost of completion). But here, since the builder (ie, the construction company) breached, it is not entitled to recover any amount, and it is irrelevant how much was saved by not building the driveway at the specified level.

Educational objective: If a builder breaches a contract during construction, the owner can recover the cost of completing or correcting the construction if it involves no undue economic waste.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 7%，C选项 15%，D选项 67%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

建筑合同违约的补偿性损害赔偿


施工开始前施工期间施工完成后
施工方违约不适用业主有权获得完工成本（业主已支付）在不造成不当经济浪费的情况下，为完工/修正成本 或 承诺的建筑价值 减去 不符合同规定的建筑价值
业主违约施工方有权获得预期利润 加上 已产生的成本 或 合同价格 减去 完工成本施工方有权获得合同价款（业主未支付）
当合同被违反时，非违约方有权获得补偿性损害赔偿。例如，当施工方在施工期间违反合同（即不符合同规定的施工），就会产生补偿性损害赔偿。在这种情况下，业主的损害赔偿是完成或修正不符合同规定的建筑的成本，前提是这不会涉及任何不当的经济浪费。获得这些损害赔偿的一种方式是从业主应付的合同价款中扣除。在本案中，价值50万美元的合同要求建造一条与公路路面齐平的车道。建筑公司违反了该合同，在岩石上建造了一条带有陡坡的车道，导致车道不安全。修正车道的3万美元成本并无不当浪费，因为这笔费用是安全进入仓库所必需的（选项A）。并且由于分销商有权从合同价格中扣除该金额，支付不超过47万美元，因此建筑公司无法获得任何赔偿。

（选项B）补偿性损害赔偿旨在使非违约方（例如，分销商）处于合同如约履行时的相同地位。因此，尽管仓库的价值超出合同价格的金额大于修正车道的成本，分销商仍有权就车道不符合同规定扣除其损害赔偿。

（选项C）如果业主在完工前违反建筑合同，施工方有权获得合同价格减去其因不必完成施工而节省的任何金额（即完工成本）。但在本案中，由于是施工方（即建筑公司）违约，它无权获得任何金额，其因未按规定水平建造车道而节省了多少钱也无关紧要。

教学目标：如果施工方在施工期间违约，业主可以要求赔偿完成或修正工程的成本，前提是这不涉及不当的经济浪费。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the measure of damages for defective construction is the cost of completion as long as it is not clearly disproportionate to the loss in value). data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：建筑合同违约赔偿

正确答案：D (Nothing)

本题考察的核心是建筑合同中的损害赔偿计算标准，特别是当承包商未能按规格建造时的“修复成本”与“经济浪费”之间的权衡。

1. 核心法律规则

一般规则：期待利益 (Expectation Damages)
合同法的目标是将非违约方置于“假如合同被完全履行”时的位置。

在建筑合同中，如果承包商违约（例如工程有缺陷），业主的标准赔偿通常是修复或完成工程的成本 (Cost of Completion/Cure)。

2. 本案逻辑分析

第一步：确定违约事实
建筑公司未按合同要求将车道建在“公路水平”，而是建成了陡坡。这构成了违约。

第二步：确定赔偿标准
通常有两种计算方式：

  • 修复成本 (Cost of Cure)：拆除并重建的费用 ($30,000)。
  • 价值减损 (Diminution in Value)：如果修复会造成巨大的经济浪费 (Economic Waste)，法院可能会判给“房屋价值的差额”。

关键判断：是否构成经济浪费？
MBE 考试中，如果缺陷导致结构不安全 (unsafe) 或 无法使用 (unusable)，通常不适用“经济浪费”原则。必须修复才能达到合同目的。

本案中，车道太陡导致“无法安全使用”，因此必须重建。正确的赔偿额是修复成本 $30,000。

3. 赔偿金计算 (The Math)

业主有权从应付给承包商的款项中扣除损害赔偿金。

合同总价 (Contract Price):     $500,000
业主已付 (Amount Paid):       -$470,000
------------------------------------
名义欠款 (Balance Due):        $30,000

减去：业主损失 (Owner's Damages): -$30,000
(即修复车道的成本)
------------------------------------
建筑公司可回收金额:             $0

因此，建筑公司起诉索赔，能拿到的最高金额是 0 (Nothing)，因为业主的抵销权 (Offset) 刚好抵消了剩余尾款。

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (经济浪费): 错误。虽然重建很贵，但因为现有车道不安全，修复它是必要的，不属于法律意义上的“不当经济浪费” (Undue Economic Waste)。著名的 Jacob & Youngs v. Kent (雷丁管案) 中适用经济浪费是因为缺陷微小且不影响使用，与本案不同。
选项 B (市场价值): 错误。合同法保护的是当事人的交易安排 (Bargain)。即使仓库现在的市值 ($550k) 已经超过了合同价，业主仍有权要求得到他所订购的“安全车道”。业主不需要因为做了一笔划算的买卖而放弃获得合格工程的权利。
选项 C (节省的成本): 错误。这是计算“违约方获益”，通常用于归还请求权 (Restitution) 或特定情况，不是计算业主期待利益损害赔偿的标准方式。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理建筑合同违约题时，问自己两个问题：

  1. 缺陷是否严重影响了功能或安全？如果是，选修复成本。
  2. 缺陷是否只是美观或微不足道，且修复成本极高？如果是，选价值减损 (避免经济浪费)。
MBE Contracts / Remedies Topic

questions.question:
A man obtained a bid of $10,000 to tear down an old structure on his newly purchased farm and another bid of $90,000 to replace it with a structure in which the man planned to house a new herd of dairy cows. Having only limited cash available, the man asked his uncle for a $100,000 loan. The next day, the man's uncle in a signed writing promised to lend the man $100,000 repayable over 10 years in equal monthly installments at 10% annual interest. The man promptly accepted the demolition bid and the old structure was removed, but the uncle thereafter refused to make the loan. Despite diligent efforts, the man was unable to obtain a loan from any other source.
In a successful claim for monetary relief against the uncle based on promissory estoppel, what is the probable measure of the man's recovery?

choices.a: Expectancy damages, measured by the difference between the value of the new structure and the old structure, less the amount of the proposed loan ($100,000).
choices.b: Expectancy damages, measured by the estimated profits from operating the dairy farm for 10 years, less the cost of repaying a $100,000 loan at 10% interest over 10 years.
choices.c: Nominal damages only, because both expectancy and reliance damages are speculative.
choices.d: Reliance damages, measured by the $10,000 expense of removing the old structure, adjusted by the decrease or increase in the market value of the man's land immediately thereafter.

The man promptly accepted the demolition bid and the old structure was removed, but the uncle thereafter refused to make the loan. Despite diligent efforts, the man was unable to obtain a loan from any other source.

In a successful claim for monetary relief against the uncle based on promissory estoppel, what is the probable measure of the man's recovery?

一名男子为其新购农场上的一座旧建筑的拆除工程获得了一份10,000美元的报价，并为原地新建一座计划用于饲养新奶牛群的建筑获得了另一份90,000美元的报价。由于手头现金有限，该男子向其叔叔请求一笔100,000美元的贷款。第二天，该男子的叔叔以书面形式签署文件，承诺向该男子出借100,000美元，该笔贷款将在10年内以10%的年利率按月等额分期偿还。该男子随即接受了拆除报价，旧建筑被拆除，但其叔叔此后拒绝提供贷款。尽管尽了最大努力，该男子仍无法从任何其他渠道获得贷款。

在基于允诺禁反言原则向其叔叔成功提起的金钱救济索赔中，该男子可能获得的赔偿额度是多少？
options:
A. Expectancy damages, measured by the difference between the value of the new structure and the old structure, less the amount of the proposed loan ($100,000).
预期损害赔偿，其计算方式为新建筑的价值与旧建筑的价值之差，再减去拟议贷款的金额（100,000美元）。

B. Expectancy damages, measured by the estimated profits from operating the dairy farm for 10 years, less the cost of repaying a $100,000 loan at 10% interest over 10 years.
预期损害赔偿，其计算方式为经营奶牛场10年的预估利润，减去在10年内以10%利率偿还100,000美元贷款的成本。

C. Nominal damages only, because both expectancy and reliance damages are speculative.
仅名义损害赔偿，因为预期损害赔偿和信赖损害赔偿都具有不确定性。

D. Reliance damages, measured by the $10,000 expense of removing the old structure, adjusted by the decrease or increase in the market value of the man's land immediately thereafter.
信赖损害赔偿，其计算方式为拆除旧建筑所花费的10,000美元费用，并根据此后该男子土地市值的增减进行调整。
data.explanation:
Promissory-estoppel damages


RelianceIntended to put enforcing party in same position as if promise had not been made Measured by out-of-pocket expenses incurred by enforcing party in reliance on promise
Expectation (rare)Intended to put enforcing party in same position as if promise had been performed Measured by nonspeculative expectation of enforcing party
Promissory estoppel allows a party to recover damages stemming from another's failure to perform a promise when no valid contract exists. However, such damages may be limited as justice requires. This typically leads to an award of reliance damages based on the out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the enforcing party. This is designed to place the enforcing party in the same position as if the promise had never been made and to avoid unjust enrichment of the enforcing party.

However, in some promissory-estoppel cases, courts have awarded expectation damages. Expectation damages are designed to put the enforcing party in the same position as if the promise had been performed. These damages usually exceed reliance damages but cannot be speculative - eg, the value of a nonexistent building, estimated profits from a nonexistent farm (Choices A & B).

Therefore, the probable measure of the man's recovery is reliance damages, measured by the expense of removing the old structure in reliance on the uncle's promise ($10,000). This amount should then be adjusted by the decrease or increase in the market value of the land after demolition to further compensate the man for losses or avoid his unjust enrichment, respectively.

(Choice C) Nominal damages (eg, $1) may be awarded when no reliance or expectation damages can be shown. But here, the man's reliance damages of $10,000 can be shown, so an award of nominal damages is inappropriate.

Educational objective: Damages for promissory estoppel may be limited as justice requires. This typically results in an award of reliance damages based on the claimant's out-of-pocket expenses, but some courts have awarded expectation damages to put the claimant in the same position as if the promise had been performed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 5%，C选项 3%，D选项 71%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

允诺禁反言损害赔偿


信赖损害赔偿旨在使主张权利方恢复到如同允诺未曾作出时的状态。以主张权利方因信赖允诺而产生的实付费用来计算。
预期损害赔偿 (罕见)旨在使主张权利方达到如同允诺已获履行时的状态。以主张权利方的非不确定性预期来计算。
当不存在有效合同时，允诺禁反言原则允许一方因另一方未能履行允诺而追讨所造成的损害赔偿。但是，此类损害赔偿可根据司法公正的要求予以限制。这通常会导致判给基于主张权利方所产生的实付费用的信赖损害赔偿。此举旨在使主张权利方恢复到如同允诺从未作出时的状态，并避免主张权利方不当得利。

然而，在某些允诺禁反言的案件中，法院也曾判给预期损害赔偿。预期损害赔偿旨在使主张权利方达到如同允诺已获履行时的状态。这类损害赔偿通常超过信赖损害赔偿，但不能是具有不确定性的——例如，一个不存在的建筑物的价值，一个不存在的农场的预估利润（选项 A 和 B）。

因此，该男子可能获得的赔偿额度是信赖损害赔偿，即依据其叔叔的允诺拆除旧建筑所花费的费用（10,000美元）来计算。然后，该金额应根据拆除后土地市值的增减进行调整，以进一步补偿该男子的损失或避免其不当得利。

（选项 C）当无法证明存在信赖损害赔偿或预期损害赔偿时，可以判给名义损害赔偿（例如1美元）。但在本案中，该男子10,000美元的信赖损害赔偿是可以证明的，因此判给名义损害赔偿是不恰当的。

教学目标：基于允诺禁反言的损害赔偿可根据司法公正的要求予以限制。这通常会判给基于索赔人实付费用的信赖损害赔偿，但一些法院也曾判给预期损害赔偿，以使索赔人达到如同允诺已获履行时的状态。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (damages for promissory-estoppel claim).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
核心考点：允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel)

当不存在具有约束力的合同时（通常因为缺乏对价 Consideration），如果一方合理地信赖了另一方的允诺并因此遭受了损害，法院可依据允诺禁反言原则给予救济。

法律依据：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90

正确答案分析

选项 D 正确

信赖损害赔偿 (Reliance Damages)

计算方式：拆除旧建筑的费用 ($10,000) ± 土地市值的变化。

推理逻辑：

  1. 原则适用：本案中，叔叔的允诺是无偿的（赠与承诺），没有对价，因此不是标准合同。但侄子基于信赖进行了拆除工作，符合允诺禁反言的构成要件。
  2. 赔偿目标：允诺禁反言的救济通常受限于“司法公正所需” (As justice requires)。这通常意味着判给信赖利益，即让受害方回到允诺从未作出时的状态 (Status quo ante)。
  3. 具体计算：
    • 直接损失：侄子为了准备建新房，花费了 $10,000 拆除旧房。这是直接的信赖支出 (Out-of-pocket expense)。
    • 价值调整：拆除旧房可能导致土地升值（如果是危房）或贬值（如果旧房有价值）。为了防止不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment) 或补偿不足，必须根据土地市值的变化对 $10,000 进行调整。

为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A & B (预期利益 Expectation Damages)
错误原因：虽然在极少数允诺禁反言案件中会判给预期利益（即如同合同已被履行），但在本案中：
  • 新业务（奶牛场）的利润具有高度投机性 (Speculative)，难以确切证明。
  • 新建筑尚未建成，其价值难以估算。
  • 通常只有在信赖利益难以计算或为了避免极度不公时，才考虑预期利益。
选项 C (名义损害赔偿 Nominal Damages)
错误原因：名义赔偿（如 $1）通常用于权利受侵犯但无实际损失的情况。本案中，侄子有明确的 $10,000 实付损失，因此不适用名义赔偿。
💡 MBE 考试通关秘籍

在处理 Promissory Estoppel 题目时，请遵循以下思维路径：

  1. 区分：首先确认是 Breach of Contract（有对价）还是 Promissory Estoppel（无对价，仅有信赖）。
  2. 首选：对于 Promissory Estoppel，首选赔偿通常是 Reliance Damages（实报实销 + 恢复原状）。
  3. 排除：如果选项涉及“未来利润” (Lost Profits)，检查是否属于“新业务” (New Business)。新业务的利润通常被视为 Speculative 而不予支持。

questions.question:
A seller entered into an agreement to sell a machine to a buyer for $5,000. At the time of the order, the buyer gave the seller a down payment of $1,000. The buyer then built a foundation for the machine at a cost of $250. The seller failed to deliver the machine.
The buyer made reasonable efforts to find a similar machine and bought one for $5,500 that did not fit on the foundation. The buyer sued the seller for breach of contract.
Which of these amounts claimed by the buyer, if any, could best be described as restitution?

choices.a: The $250 cost of the foundation.
choices.b: The $500 difference in price.
choices.c: The $1,000 down payment.
choices.d: None of the claimed amounts.

data.questionStem:
Q81201

A seller entered into an agreement to sell a machine to a buyer for $5,000. At the time of the order, the buyer gave the seller a down payment of $1,000. The buyer then built a foundation for the machine at a cost of $250. The seller failed to deliver the machine.

The buyer made reasonable efforts to find a similar machine and bought one for $5,500 that did not fit on the foundation. The buyer sued the seller for breach of contract.

Which of these amounts claimed by the buyer, if any, could best be described as restitution?

一名卖方与一名买方签订协议，以5000美元的价格向其出售一台机器。下订单时，买方向卖方支付了1000美元的定金。随后，买方为该机器建造了一个地基，花费了250美元。卖方未能交付该机器。

买方付出了合理的努力去寻找一台类似的机器，并以5500美元的价格购买了一台，但这台机器与所建地基不匹配。

买方以违约为由起诉了卖方。

买方索赔的这些金额中（如有），哪一项最能被描述为返还财产（restitution）？
options:
A. The $250 cost of the foundation.
建造地基的250美元成本。

B. The $500 difference in price.
500美元的差价。

C. The $1,000 down payment.
1000美元的定金。

D. None of the claimed amounts.
以上皆非。
data.explanation:
Restitutionary damages


DefinitionDamages awarded to restore to claimant the value of whatever benefit was conferred upon recipient
PurposePrevent unjust enrichment
MeasureReasonable value of work performed or services rendered (ie, cost of recipient obtaining comparable performance) If applicable, extent to which recipient's property has increased in value or recipient's other interests have been advanced
Restitutionary damages are awarded to restore to a contracting party the value of any benefit conferred on the other party. Under the UCC, where the seller fails to deliver the promised goods or the buyer rightfully rejects the goods, the buyer is entitled to the return of any payment made on the goods as restitution.

Here, the buyer paid the seller a $1,000 down payment for a machine that the seller failed to deliver. As a result, the $1,000 down payment is the amount that could best be described as restitution (Choice C).

(Choices A & B) Neither the $250 cost of the foundation nor the $500 difference between the contract price of the seller's machine and the price of the substitute machine (ie, cost of cover) conferred a benefit on the seller (not restitution). However, the buyer could likely recover both costs as part of his/her expectation measure of damages.

Educational objective: Where a seller fails to deliver the promised goods or the buyer rightfully rejects them, the buyer is entitled to the return of any payment made on the goods as restitution.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 12%，C选项 53%（正确选项），D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

返还财产损害赔偿


定义为将受益人所获利益的价值返还给索赔人而判定的损害赔偿
目的防止不当得利
衡量标准所完成工作或提供服务的合理价值（即，受益人获得同等履行所需支付的成本）。如适用，还包括受益人财产增值的程度或其其他利益得到提升的程度。
返还财产损害赔偿（Restitutionary damages）旨在将一方当事人授予另一方当事人的任何利益的价值返还给该方。根据UCC，当卖方未能交付承诺的货物，或买方正当拒收货物时，买方有权要求返还已支付的任何款项，作为返还财产（restitution）。

在本案中，买方向卖方支付了1000美元定金，用于购买一台机器，但卖方未能交付。因此，这1000美元的定金是最能被描述为返还财产（restitution）的金额（选项C）。

（选项A和B）建造地基的250美元成本，以及卖方机器合同价与替代机器价格之间的500美元差价（即，补进成本/cost of cover），均未给卖方带来利益（因此不属于返还财产）。但是，买方很可能可以作为其期望损害赔偿的一部分，收回这两笔费用。

教学目的：当卖方未能交付承诺的货物，或买方正当拒收货物时，买方有权要求返还已支付的任何款项，作为返还财产（restitution）。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code（美国统一商法典）

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 344 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (purpose of remedies).
  • U.C.C. § 2-711 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's remedies in general).
  • U.C.C. § 2-713 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's damages for nondelivery/repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts & Remedies (合同法与救济)

💡 核心概念：返还财产 (Restitution)

Restitution 的核心目的是防止不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。它要求违约方将其从受害方那里获得的利益 (Benefit Conferred) 返还给受害方。

📊 题目金额逐项分析

本题要求找出哪一笔金额属于 Restitution。我们需要判断哪笔钱“进入了卖方的口袋”。

✅
$1,000 定金 (Down Payment)
Restitution Interest
这笔钱是买方直接支付给卖方的。卖方持有这笔钱却未交付机器，构成了不当得利。因此，要求退还这笔钱属于返还财产 (Restitution)。 正确答案
❌
$250 地基成本 (Foundation Cost)
Reliance Interest (信赖利益)
这是买方基于对合同的信赖而支出的费用。虽然买方损失了这笔钱，但卖方并没有得到这笔钱（没有获益）。这属于信赖损害赔偿，而非 Restitution。
❌
$500 差价 (Price Difference)
Expectation Interest (期待利益)
这是买方为了达到合同履行后的状态而额外支付的成本（Cost of Cover）。这旨在弥补买方的预期损失，属于期待损害赔偿，而非 Restitution。
⚖️ 法律依据 (UCC)

根据 UCC § 2-711，当卖方未交付货物时，买方有权获得的救济包括：取消合同并收回已支付的价款 (Recovering so much of the price as has been paid)。

🎓 考场解题技巧

在区分合同法的三种赔偿利益时，请自问以下问题：

  • Restitution: 被告拿走了什么？(Focus on Defendant's gain)
  • Reliance: 原告白花了什么？(Focus on Plaintiff's out-of-pocket loss)
  • Expectation: 原告本该赚到什么？(Focus on the value of the bargain)
总结： 只有直接转移给违约方（卖方）的利益（即定金）才属于 Restitution。其他的花费属于 Reliance 或 Expectation damages。

questions.question:
A high-volume pleasure-boat retailer with a nearly inexhaustible supply of boats entered into a written contract with a boater, signed by both parties, to sell him a power boat for $12,000. The manufacturer's price of the boat delivered to the retailer was $9,500. As the contract provided, the boater paid the retailer $4,000 in advance and promised to pay the full balance upon the boat's delivery. The contract contained no liquidated damages provision.
Prior to the agreed delivery date, the boater notified the retailer that he would be financially unable to conclude the purchase; and the retailer thereupon resold the same boat that the boater had ordered to a third person for $12,000 cash.
If the boater sues the retailer for restitution of the $4,000 advance payment, how should the court decide?

choices.a: The boater's claim should be denied, because, as the party in default, he is deemed to have lost any right to restitution of a benefit conferred on the retailer.
choices.b: The boater's claim should be denied, because, but for his repudiation, the retailer would have made a profit on two boat-sales instead of one.
choices.c: The boater's claim should be upheld in the amount of $3,500 ($4,000 minus $500 as statutory damages under the UCC).
choices.d: The boater's claim should be upheld in the amount of $4,000 minus the amount of the retailer's lost profit under its contract with the boater.

data.questionStem:
Q81196

A high-volume pleasure-boat retailer with a nearly inexhaustible supply of boats entered into a written contract with a boater, signed by both parties, to sell him a power boat for $12,000. The manufacturer's price of the boat delivered to the retailer was $9,500. As the contract provided, the boater paid the retailer $4,000 in advance and promised to pay the full balance upon the boat's delivery. The contract contained no liquidated damages provision.

Prior to the agreed delivery date, the boater notified the retailer that he would be financially unable to conclude the purchase; and the retailer thereupon resold the same boat that the boater had ordered to a third person for $12,000 cash.

If the boater sues the retailer for restitution of the $4,000 advance payment, how should the court decide?

一家拥有几乎无限船只供应的高销量游艇零售商，与一名船夫签订了一份由双方签字的书面合同，以12,000美元的价格向其出售一艘摩托艇。制造商交付给零售商的船只价格为9,500美元。根据合同规定，船夫向零售商预付了4,000美元，并承诺在船只交付时付清余款。该合同不包含违约赔偿金条款。

在约定的交付日期之前，船夫通知零售商，他因经济原因无法完成购买；零售商因此将船夫订购的同一艘船以12,000美元现金转售给第三方。

如果船夫起诉零售商，要求返还其4,000美元的预付款，法院应如何判决？
options:
A. The boater's claim should be denied, because, as the party in default, he is deemed to have lost any right to restitution of a benefit conferred on the retailer.
船夫的诉求应被驳回，因为作为违约方，他被视为已丧失要求返还其给予零售商的利益的任何权利。

B. The boater's claim should be denied, because, but for his repudiation, the retailer would have made a profit on two boat-sales instead of one.
船夫的诉求应被驳回，因为若非他拒绝履行合同，零售商本可以从两笔船只销售中获利，而不是一笔。

C. The boater's claim should be upheld in the amount of $3,500 ($4,000 minus $500 as statutory damages under the UCC).
船夫的诉求应被支持，金额为3,500美元（即4,000美元减去UCC规定的500美元法定损害赔偿金）。

D. The boater's claim should be upheld in the amount of $4,000 minus the amount of the retailer's lost profit under its contract with the boater.
船夫的诉求应被支持，金额为4,000美元减去零售商根据其与船夫的合同所损失的利润金额。
data.explanation:
Breaching buyer's recovery of advance payment

(UCC § 2-718) Buyer who made advance payment before breach can recover amount paid minus seller's:

  • liquidated damages - amount set forth in contract
  • statutory damages - 20% of contract price or $500, whichever is less (if no valid liquidated damages clause)


OR

  • actual damages - expectation damages plus any incidental damages (if amount exceeds statutory damages)


UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the UCC, a breaching buyer is entitled to restitution damages for the value of any advance payments it made to the seller. This ensures that the seller is not unjustly enriched at the buyer's expense (Choice A). However, the buyer's damages award will be offset by the seller's damages. If, as here, there is no liquidated damages provision, then the seller's offset is the greater of the following:

  • Statutory damages - $500 or 20% of the total contract price, whichever is smaller
  • Actual damages - expectation damages (eg, lost profits if the seller is a lost-volume seller), plus any incidental damages (eg, shipping or transportation costs)


Therefore, an injured seller is not limited to a $500 statutory offset when the seller's actual damages exceed that amount (Choice C).

Here, the retailer is a lost-volume seller, as evidenced by its nearly inexhaustible supply of boats. But for the boater's breach, the retailer would have made two sales (and two profits) rather than one. As a result, the retailer's actual damages are its lost profit from the sale to the boater plus incidental damages (none are indicated). The boater's claim should therefore be upheld in the amount of $4,000 for the advance payment minus the amount of the retailer's lost profit.

(Choice B) The retailer would have made a profit on two boat sales instead of one had the boater not repudiated the contract. However, since the boater is entitled to restitution of the $4,000 advance payment, the retailer's lost profit (from the sale to the boater) will be subtracted from - but not negate - the boater's claim.

Educational objective: Under the UCC, a breaching buyer is entitled to restitution damages for the value of any advance payments it made to the seller, minus the amount of the seller's damages.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 28%，C选项 4%，D选项 63%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

违约买方对预付款的追偿

(UCC § 2-718) 在违约前支付了预付款的买方，可以追回已支付的金额，但需减去卖方的：

  • 违约赔偿金 - 合同中规定的金额
  • 法定损害赔偿金 - 合同价格的20%或500美元，以较少者为准（若无有效的违约赔偿金条款）


或

  • 实际损害赔偿 - 预期损害赔偿加上任何附带损害赔偿（如果金额超过法定损害赔偿）


UCC = 美国统一商法典 (Uniform Commercial Code)。

根据UCC，违约买方有权就其向卖方支付的任何预付款的价值获得返还性损害赔偿。这确保了卖方不会因买方的损失而不当得利(选项A)。然而，买方的损害赔偿金将被卖方的损害赔偿金抵销。如果像本案一样，没有违约赔偿金条款，那么卖方的抵销额是以下各项中的较大者：

  • 法定损害赔偿金 - 500美元或合同总价的20%，以较小者为准
  • 实际损害赔偿 - 预期损害赔偿（例如，如果卖方是“销量损失型卖方”，则为损失的利润），加上任何附带损害赔偿（例如，运输费用）


因此，当受损害的卖方的实际损害赔偿超过500美元时，其不限于500美元的法定抵销额(选项C)。

在本案中，该零售商是“销量损失型卖方”，其几乎无穷无尽的船只供应量证明了这一点。若非船夫违约，零售商本可以完成两笔销售（并获得两份利润），而不是一笔。因此，零售商的实际损害赔偿是其因与船夫的销售而损失的利润，加上附带损害赔偿（本案未指明）。因此，船夫要求返还4,000美元预付款的诉求应被支持，但需减去零售商损失的利润金额。

(选项 B) 若船夫没有拒绝履行合同，零售商本可以从两笔船只销售中获利，而不是一笔。然而，由于船夫有权要求返还4,000美元的预付款，零售商的损失利润（来自与船夫的销售）将从船夫的诉求中扣除，但不会使其诉求无效。

教学目标：根据UCC，违约买方有权就其向卖方支付的任何预付款的价值获得返还性损害赔偿，但需减去卖方的损害赔偿金额。

References

U.C.C. § 2-718 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (liquidation or limitation of damages and deposits).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：违约买方的预付款返还

本题考察的是美国统一商法典（UCC）中关于违约买方（Breaching Buyer）要求返还预付款的权利，以及销量损失型卖方（Lost Volume Seller）的损害赔偿计算。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule)

UCC § 2-718(2)
即使买方违约，他也有权要求返还其支付的预付款（Restitution），但必须扣除卖方的损害赔偿。
卖方可以扣除的金额是以下两者中的较大者：
  • 法定损害赔偿 (Statutory Damages)：500美元或合同价格的20%（取较小值）。
  • 实际损害赔偿 (Actual Damages)：卖方因违约遭受的实际损失。

🚤 关键概念：销量损失型卖方

Lost Volume Seller

本题最关键的细节在于：零售商拥有“几乎无限的供应量” (nearly inexhaustible supply)。

通常情况下，如果卖方将货物转售给第三方且价格相同，卖方似乎没有损失。但是，对于拥有无限库存的零售商来说，情况并非如此。

逻辑推理：

  • 如果买方没有违约，零售商本可以卖出两艘船（一艘给原买家，一艘给第三方）。
  • 因为买方违约，零售商只卖出了一艘船（给第三方）。
  • 因此，转售并没有“弥补”损失，零售商实际上损失了一笔销售的利润。

根据 UCC § 2-708(2)，此类卖方的实际损害赔偿就是损失的利润 (Lost Profit)。

🧮 判决计算公式

返还金额 = 预付款 - 卖方损失的利润
在本案中：
  • 预付款：$4,000
  • 卖方实际损失：$2,500（即 $12,000 售价 - $9,500 成本）
  • 法定扣除额：$500（因为 $500 < $2,400 [20% of price]）

由于卖方的实际损失 ($2,500) 远大于法定扣除额 ($500)，卖方有权扣除其实际损失。

因此，买方可以拿回：
$4,000 - 损失的利润 = 最终返还额

这正是 选项 D 的描述。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 A (全部没收)：错误。UCC 拒绝了普通法中违约方无权要求返还利益的严苛规则，旨在防止卖方不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。
  • 选项 B (全部扣留)：错误。虽然卖方确实损失了利润，但这并不意味着他可以扣留全部预付款。他只能扣留相当于损失利润的那部分，剩余的必须返还。
  • 选项 C (仅扣除$500)：错误。$500 的法定限额仅适用于卖方没有证明更大实际损失的情况。一旦证明了实际损失（利润）高于 $500，就按实际损失计算。
💡 MBE 考试技巧： 看到“unlimited supply”、“high-volume retailer”或“inventory”等字眼时，立即警惕 Lost Volume Seller 考点。此时，转售价格（Resale Price）通常是干扰项，关键在于利润（Profit）的损失。

questions.question:
A seller and a buyer, standing on a 10-acre tract of land, orally agreed to its sale and purchase for $5,000, and orally marked its bounds as "that line of trees down there, the ditch that intersects them, the fence on the other side, and that street on the fourth side."
In which of the following is the remedy of reformation most appropriate?

choices.a: As later reduced to writing, the agreement by clerical mistake included two acres that are actually beyond the fence.
choices.b: The buyer reasonably thought that a dilapidated shed backed up against the fence was to be torn down and removed as part of the agreement, but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement said nothing about the shed.
choices.c: The buyer reasonably thought that the price orally agreed upon was $4,500, but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement said $5,000.
choices.d: The buyer reasonably thought that two acres beyond the fence were included in the oral agreement but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement included the two acres.

data.questionStem:
Q81202

A seller and a buyer, standing on a 10-acre tract of land, orally agreed to its sale and purchase for $5,000, and orally marked its bounds as "that line of trees down there, the ditch that intersects them, the fence on the other side, and that street on the fourth side."

In which of the following is the remedy of reformation most appropriate?

卖方和买方站在一块10英亩的土地上，口头同意以5000美元的价格进行买卖，并口头将其边界标记为“那边的树林、与树林相交的沟渠、另一边的栅栏以及第四边的街道。”

在下列哪种情况中，合同修正 (reformation) 的救济措施最为适当？
options:
A. As later reduced to writing, the agreement by clerical mistake included two acres that are actually beyond the fence.
之后在拟定书面合同时，由于文书错误，协议包含了实际上在栅栏之外的两英亩土地。

B. The buyer reasonably thought that a dilapidated shed backed up against the fence was to be torn down and removed as part of the agreement, but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement said nothing about the shed.
买方合理地认为，作为协议的一部分，那个靠着栅栏的破旧棚屋将被拆除，但卖方并不同意。之后拟定的书面协议对该棚屋只字未提。

C. The buyer reasonably thought that the price orally agreed upon was $4,500, but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement said $5,000.
买方合理地认为口头约定的价格是4500美元，但卖方并不同意。之后拟定的书面协议写明价格为5000美元。

D. The buyer reasonably thought that two acres beyond the fence were included in the oral agreement but the seller did not. As later reduced to writing, the agreement included the two acres.
买方合理地认为栅栏外的两英亩土地包含在口头协议中，但卖方并不同意。之后拟定的书面协议包含了这两英亩土地。
data.explanation:
Availability of reformation as a remedy


MisrepresentationOne party makes untrue assertion of fact that is fraudulent or material Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation
Mutual mistakeBoth parties are mistaken as to contract's contents or legal effect
Unilateral mistake (from fraudulent misrepresentation)One party is mistaken because other party intentionally misrepresented contract's content or legal effect Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation
Reformation is an equitable remedy that courts can use to rewrite a contract to reflect the parties' original intent. This remedy is available when a writing that embodies an agreement fails to express the agreement because of a mistake by both parties as to its content or legal effect. When reformation is available to cure a mutual mistake, neither party can avoid the contract.

Here, the parties agreed to the sale and purchase of a 10-acre tract of land and orally marked its bounds, including "the fence on the other side." Due to a clerical mistake, the written agreement included two acres beyond the fence (ie, two acres neither party intended to include as part of the transaction). Therefore, at the request of either party, the court may reform the writing to cure their mutual mistake.

(Choices B, C & D) The buyer and seller did not agree to the same terms, so it would be impossible to reform the writing to reflect their actual agreement. Instead, no contract exists because there was no meeting of the minds.

Educational objective: A court may reform a contract that fails to accurately express the parties' agreement because of a mistake by both parties as to its content or legal effect.

选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 5%，D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

作为救济措施的合同修正 (reformation) 的适用性


虚假陈述 (Misrepresentation)一方作出了欺诈性或实质性的不实事实断言，受不利影响的一方正当地依赖于该虚假陈述
共同误解 (Mutual mistake)双方均对合同内容或其法律效力存在误解
单方误解 (Unilateral mistake) (因欺诈性虚假陈述所致)一方因另一方故意歪曲合同内容或其法律效力而产生误解，受不利影响的一方正当地依赖于该虚假陈述
合同修正 (Reformation) 是一种衡平法上的救济措施，法院可据此重写合同，以反映双方的原始意图。当体现协议的书面文件因双方均对其内容或法律效力存在误解而未能表达出真实协议时，可适用此救济措施。当可以适用合同修正来纠正共同误解时，任何一方都不能撤销该合同。

在本案中，双方同意买卖一块10英亩的土地，并口头标记了其边界，包括“另一边的栅栏”。由于文书错误，书面协议包含了栅栏之外的两英亩土地（即，双方均无意将这两英亩土地纳入交易）。因此，经任何一方请求，法院可以修正该书面文件，以纠正他们的共同误解。

（选项 B、C 和 D）买方和卖方未就相同条款达成一致，因此不可能修正书面文件以反映他们的实际协议。实际上，由于“意思表示不一致”(no meeting of the minds)，合同并未成立。

教学目的：当合同因双方均对其内容或法律效力存在误解而未能准确表达双方协议时，法院可以对该合同进行修正。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 155 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (mistake of both parties justifying reformation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Remedies
核心考点：合同修正 (Reformation)

Reformation 是一种衡平法救济 (Equitable Remedy)。当书面合同因为双方的共同错误 (Mutual Mistake) 或文书错误 (Clerical Error)，未能准确反映双方已经达成的真实协议时，法院可以“重写”合同以反映真实意图。

第一步：双方达成口头合意
(Meeting of the Minds)
↓
第二步：书面记录出错
(Scrivener's Error / Clerical Mistake)
↓
救济：合同修正
(Reformation)

选项分析

正确答案 A

分析：在本案中，买卖双方站在土地上，明确指出了边界（栅栏）。这表明双方就标的物达成了明确的合意 (Meeting of the Minds)。

然而，在将协议落实为书面文件时，发生了文书错误 (Clerical Mistake)，导致书面内容（包含栅栏外的两英亩）与双方的口头合意不符。这属于典型的共同错误 (Mutual Mistake) —— 不是对交易内容的误解，而是对“书面记录是否反映了协议”的误解。

因此，法院最适合使用 Reformation 来修正书面错误，使其符合双方原本的口头协议。

为什么 B、C、D 是错误的？

这三个选项的共同点是：双方从未达成一致 (No Meeting of the Minds)。
  • 选项 B：买方认为包括拆棚屋，卖方不同意。
  • 选项 C：买方认为是 $4,500，卖方认为是 $5,000。
  • 选项 D：买方认为包括额外两英亩，卖方不同意。

在这些情况下，双方对合同的核心条款（价格、标的物范围、义务）存在根本性的误解。既然没有达成过“原始协议”，法院就无法“修正”书面文件来反映一个不存在的协议。

此时适当的救济通常是撤销合同 (Rescission)，而不是修正。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Reformation 题目时，请寻找以下关键词：
1. "Clerical error" (文书错误) 或 "Scrivener's error" (代书错误)。
2. "Reduced to writing" (落实到书面) 时发生的变化。

关键区别：
如果双方想的一样，但写错了 ➡️ 选 Reformation。
如果双方想的不一样（根本没谈拢） ➡️ 选 No Contract 或 Rescission，绝对不能选 Reformation。

questions.question:
A job-search website provided consumers with online access to job openings based upon the consumer's location and specific area of expertise. The website wanted to expand the usefulness of its services, so it hired a production company to produce instructional videos regarding the job-hiring process, ranging from how to write a resume to interviewing tips. The written agreement dated September 20 stipulated that the production company would produce 10 five-minute instructional videos regarding the interview process based upon the general guidelines provided by the website regarding video content. The website agreed to pay $1,500 for each video, provided that the video was in high definition. The contract called for all of the videos to be completed by November 20. Due to issues regarding the availability of video cameras, the production company delivered the 10 videos in standard definition on November 30. Nonetheless, the website used the standard-definition videos, but it refused to pay the production company for its services.
Can the production company recover any damages from the website for providing the 10 videos in standard definition on November 30?

choices.a: No, because the production company breached the contract.
choices.b: No, because the contract contained an express condition that the videos be in high definition.
choices.c: Yes, because the website used the standard-definition videos on its website.
choices.d: Yes, because there was no "time is of the essence" clause in the contract.

questions.question:
A homeowner and a contractor entered into a contract for the construction of a home for $300,000. The contractor was to earn a profit of $10,000 for the job. After the contractor had spent $45,000 on labor and materials, including $5,000 on oak flooring not yet installed, the homeowner informed the contractor that the homeowner had lost her job and could not pay the contractor for his services. The homeowner told the contractor to stop working immediately.
The reasonable market value of the labor and materials provided by the contractor at that point, including the oak flooring, was $40,000. The contractor used the oak flooring on another job.
In an action by the contractor against the homeowner for damages, which of the following would be the largest amount of damages recoverable by the contractor?

choices.a: $40,000, the contractor's construction costs.
choices.b: $40,000, the reasonable value of the services the contractor had provided.
choices.c: $50,000, the contractor's construction costs of $45,000 plus the $10,000 profit minus the $5,000 saved by reusing the oak flooring on another job.
choices.d: $55,000, the contractor's construction costs of $45,000 plus the $10,000 profit.

data.questionStem:
Q81198

A homeowner and a contractor entered into a contract for the construction of a home for $300,000. The contractor was to earn a profit of $10,000 for the job. After the contractor had spent $45,000 on labor and materials, including $5,000 on oak flooring not yet installed, the homeowner informed the contractor that the homeowner had lost her job and could not pay the contractor for his services. The homeowner told the contractor to stop working immediately.

The reasonable market value of the labor and materials provided by the contractor at that point, including the oak flooring, was $40,000. The contractor used the oak flooring on another job.

In an action by the contractor against the homeowner for damages, which of the following would be the largest amount of damages recoverable by the contractor?

一位房主与一位承包商签订了一份价值30万美元的房屋建造合同。承包商将从此项工作中获得1万美元的利润。在承包商已花费4.5万美元用于劳务和材料（其中包括5000美元尚未安装的橡木地板）后，房主告知承包商她已失业，无法支付其服务费用。房主让承包商立即停工。

当时，承包商所提供的劳务和材料（包括橡木地板）的合理市场价值为4万美元。承包商将橡木地板用于另一项工作。

在承包商对房主提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，承包商可获得的最高赔偿金额是下列哪一项？
options:
A. $40,000, the contractor's construction costs.
$40,000，承包商的建造成本。

B. $40,000, the reasonable value of the services the contractor had provided.
$40,000，承包商已提供服务的合理价值。

C. $50,000, the contractor's construction costs of $45,000 plus the $10,000 profit minus the $5,000 saved by reusing the oak flooring on another job.
$50,000，即承包商的建造成本45,000美元加上10,000美元的利润，再减去因将橡木地板用于另一项工作而节省的5,000美元。

D. $55,000, the contractor's construction costs of $45,000 plus the $10,000 profit.
$55,000，即承包商的建造成本45,000美元加上10,000美元的利润。
data.explanation:
Compensatory damages for breach of construction contracts


Before construction startsDuring constructionAfter construction completed
Breach by builder
(owner paid)
Owner entitled to:		N/ACost of completionCost of completion/correction if no undue economic waste OR value of promised construction minus nonconforming construction
Breach by owner
(did not pay)
Builder entitled to:		Lost profitsLost profits plus costs incurred OR contract price minus cost of completionContract price
Compensatory damages are intended to place the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been performed (ie, give that party the benefit of the bargain). Where an owner breaches a construction contract before or during construction, the builder is entitled to recover the profits it would have earned had the contract been completed plus costs incurred up to that point. However, any costs saved or otherwise avoided (ie, mitigated) by the builder will be subtracted to arrive at the final damages award.

Here, the contractor had spent $45,000 on labor and materials when the homeowner stopped the work. And the contractor had expected to make a $10,000 profit for this job. As a result, he would be entitled to recover $55,000 except that he saved $5,000 by using the oak flooring on another job. Therefore, the largest amount of damages recoverable by the contractor is $50,000 ($10,000 expected profit + $45,000 costs incurred - $5,000 costs saved) (Choice C).

(Choice A) The contractor's $40,000 construction costs ($45,000 costs incurred - $5,000 costs saved) represent his reliance damages - ie, damages intended to place the injured party in the same position as if the contract had never been entered. But this measure of recovery fails to account for the contractor's $10,000 anticipated profit.

(Choice B) Restitution damages are measured by the benefit conferred on another party. But here, the $40,000 amount (reasonable value of the services the contractor had provided) is an incorrect measure of restitution damages since it fails to deduct the $5,000 worth of oak flooring the contractor used on another job. $35,000 would be the correct measure, and this represents the smallest amount of recoverable damages.

Educational objective: When an owner breaches a construction contract before or during construction, the builder's damages are equal to the builder's lost profits plus costs incurred, minus any costs saved or otherwise avoided.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 10%，C选项 75%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

建筑合同违约的补偿性损害赔偿


施工开始前施工期间施工完成后
建筑商违约
(业主已付款)
业主有权获得：		不适用完工成本在无不当经济浪费情况下的完工/修正成本，或承诺的建筑价值减去不合规建筑的价值
业主违约
(未付款)
建筑商有权获得：		损失的利润损失的利润加上已发生的成本，或合同价格减去完工成本合同价格
补偿性损害赔偿旨在使非违约方处于合同如同已履行一样的状态（即，给予该方期待利益）。当业主在施工前或施工期间违反建筑合同时，建筑商有权获得合同完成本可赚取的利润加上截至该时间点已发生的成本。但是，建筑商节省或以其他方式避免的（即，已减损的）任何成本都将被减去，以得出最终的损害赔偿金额。

在本案中，当房主停止工作时，承包商已花费45,000美元用于劳务和材料。并且承包商预期从此项工作中获得10,000美元的利润。因此，他本有权获得55,000美元，但他因将橡木地板用于另一项工作而节省了5,000美元。因此，承包商可获得的最高损害赔偿金额为50,000美元（10,000美元预期利润 + 45,000美元已发生成本 - 5,000美元节省成本）（选项C）。

（选项A） 承包商的40,000美元建造成本（45,000美元已发生成本 - 5,000美元节省成本）代表了他的信赖损害赔偿——即，旨在使受害方处于如同从未签订合同一样的状态的损害赔偿。但这种赔偿计算方式未能计入承包商10,000美元的预期利润。

（选项B） 恢复原状损害赔偿是根据给予另一方的利益来衡量的。但在本案中，40,000美元的金额（承包商已提供服务的合理价值）是对恢复原状损害赔偿的不正确计算，因为它未能扣除承包商用于另一项工作的价值5,000美元的橡木地板。35,000美元才是正确的计算结果，而这代表了可获得的最小损害赔偿金额。

教学目标：当业主在施工前或施工期间违反建筑合同时，建筑商的损害赔偿等于其损失的利润加上已发生的成本，再减去任何节省或以其他方式避免的成本。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 344 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (purpose of remedies).

MBE 考点解析：建筑合同违约赔偿

本题考察的核心知识点是当业主（Owner）在施工期间违约时，承包商（Contractor）可以获得的期待利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages) 的计算方法。

核心原则：
合同法的基本目标是让非违约方处于“如同合同已完全履行”的状态。这被称为“交易的利益” (Benefit of the Bargain)。

1. 计算公式

当业主在完工前违约，承包商的标准赔偿计算公式如下：

赔偿金 = 预期利润 + 已发生成本 - 避免的损失
(Damages = Expected Profit + Costs Incurred - Loss Avoided)

2. 本题案情分析

我们需要代入题目中的具体数字：

预期利润 (Expected Profit) $10,000
已发生成本 (Costs Incurred) + $45,000
避免的损失 (Mitigation/Savings) - $5,000
*注：承包商将价值$5,000的橡木地板用于了另一项工作，这部分成本被“回收”或“节省”了，因此必须扣除。
最高可获赔偿 (Total Damages) $50,000

因此，选项 C 是正确答案。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A ($40,000) - 信赖利益 (Reliance Damages)：
    这是为了让承包商回到“从未签订合同”的状态（即只赔偿净成本 $45k - $5k）。虽然这也是一种计算方法，但题目问的是“最大”赔偿额。期待利益（包含利润）通常高于信赖利益。
  • 选项 B ($40,000) - 恢复原状 (Restitution)：
    这是基于房主获得的“不当得利” (Unjust Enrichment) 的价值。虽然已完成工作的市场价值是 $40k，但承包商并未将那 $5k 的地板给房主（他自己拿去用了）。更重要的是，在合同有效的情况下，期待利益通常是首选且金额最高的救济方式。
  • 选项 D ($55,000) - 忽略减损义务：
    这个选项计算了利润加成本，但忘记扣除承包商通过再利用地板而节省下来的 $5,000。根据减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate)，原本会损失但实际上已避免的成本不能获得赔偿。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理建筑合同违约计算题时，请遵循以下步骤：
  1. 确定是谁违约（本题是业主）。
  2. 确定违约时间（本题是施工期间）。
  3. 首先尝试计算期待利益（利润 + 成本）。
  4. 关键点：一定要检查是否有“节省的成本”或“材料再利用”的情况，这部分必须从赔偿金中扣除。

questions.question:
The owner of a house and a real estate investor signed a writing in which the owner, "in consideration of $100 to be paid to the owner by the investor," offered the investor the right to purchase the house for $100,000 within 30 days. The writing further provided, "This offer will become effective as an option only if and when the $100 consideration is in fact paid."
Two weeks later, the owner, having received no payment or other communication from the investor, sold and conveyed the house to the investor's business rival for $120,000. The following day, the owner received a letter from the investor enclosing a cashier's check for $100 payable to the owner and stating, "I am hereby exercising my option to purchase the house and am prepared to close whenever you're ready."
Assume that, for whatever reason, the investor prevails in a suit against the owner for breach of contract.
Which of the following is the investor entitled to recover?

choices.a: $20,000, plus the amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the house on the date of the owner's breach exceeded $120,000.
choices.b: Nominal damages only, because the remedy of specific performance was not available to the investor.
choices.c: The amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the house on the date of the owner's breach exceeded $100,000.
choices.d: The fair market value, if any, of an assignable option to purchase the house for $100,000.

data.questionStem:
Q81212

The owner of a house and a real estate investor signed a writing in which the owner, "in consideration of $100 to be paid to the owner by the investor," offered the investor the right to purchase the house for $100,000 within 30 days. The writing further provided, "This offer will become effective as an option only if and when the $100 consideration is in fact paid."

Two weeks later, the owner, having received no payment or other communication from the investor, sold and conveyed the house to the investor's business rival for $120,000. The following day, the owner received a letter from the investor enclosing a cashier's check for $100 payable to the owner and stating, "I am hereby exercising my option to purchase the house and am prepared to close whenever you're ready."

Assume that, for whatever reason, the investor prevails in a suit against the owner for breach of contract.

Which of the following is the investor entitled to recover?

一位房屋所有人和一位房地产投资者签署了一份书面文件，该文件中，房屋所有人“以投资者将支付给所有人的100美元为对价”，向投资者发出要约，给予其在30天内以100,000美元购买该房屋的权利。该书面文件进一步规定，“只有当100美元的对价实际支付后，该要约才作为一项期权生效。”

两周后，房屋所有人在未收到投资者任何付款或其他通知的情况下，以120,000美元的价格将房屋出售并转让给了该投资者的商业竞争对手。第二天，房屋所有人收到了投资者的一封信，内附一张支付给所有人的100美元银行本票，信中写道：“我在此行使我的购房期权，并准备好随时完成交易。”

假设，无论出于何种原因，投资者在对房屋所有人提起的违约诉讼中胜诉。

投资者有权获得以下哪项赔偿？
options:
A. $20,000, plus the amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the house on the date of the owner's breach exceeded $120,000.
20,000美元，加上在房屋所有人违约之日，房屋公平市价超出120,000美元的部分（如有）。

B. Nominal damages only, because the remedy of specific performance was not available to the investor.
仅象征性损害赔偿，因为投资者无法获得实际履行救济。

C. The amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the house on the date of the owner's breach exceeded $100,000.
在房屋所有人违约之日，房屋公平市价超出100,000美元的部分（如有）。

D. The fair market value, if any, of an assignable option to purchase the house for $100,000.
一项可转让的、以100,000美元购买该房屋的期权的公平市价（如有）。
data.explanation:
A buyer who enters a contract for the sale of land expects to receive the property (worth its fair market value) in exchange for the contract price. If the seller breaches by refusing to sell, the buyer can recover for loss of bargain (ie, lost expectation), which amounts to the property's fair market value on the date of the breach minus the contract price.

Here, the real estate investor paid $100 for the option to buy the owner's house for $100,000. The investor exercised this option, and the owner breached the resulting land-sales contract since he had already sold the house to the business rival. Therefore, the investor is entitled to recover for his lost expectation, which is the amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the house on the date of the breach exceeded $100,000.

(Choice A) Although the owner sold the house to the business rival for $20,000 more than the investor had agreed to pay, the investor cannot automatically recover that $20,000. This is because the investor's expectation is based on his own contract price - not the business rival's.

(Choice B) Nominal damages (eg, $1) can be awarded for breach when there was no substantial loss - not because specific performance is unavailable. Here, the investor likely did suffer a substantial loss since, based on the business rival's $120,000 payment, the fair market value of the house likely exceeded $100,000.

(Choice D) Options are generally assignable (ie, transferable). But the damages for breaching an option are equal to the lost expectation of the nonbreaching party - which is distinct from (and likely greater than) the fair market value of the assignable option itself.

Educational objective:

When a seller breaches a land-sales contract by refusing to sell the property to the buyer, the buyer can recover for loss of bargain - ie, the fair market value of the property on the date of the breach minus the contract price.



选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 28%，C选项 43%（正确选项），D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

签订土地买卖合同的买方期望以合同价格换取该财产（其价值等于其公平市价）。如果卖方因拒绝出售而违约，买方可以就交易损失（即预期利益损失）获得赔偿，赔偿金额为违约当日该财产的公平市价与合同价格的差额。

在本案中，该房地产投资者支付了100美元以获得以100,000美元购买该房屋的期权。投资者行使了该期权，而房屋所有人因已将房屋出售给商业竞争对手而违反了由此产生的土地买卖合同。因此，投资者有权就其预期利益损失获得赔偿，即在违约之日，房屋公平市价超出100,000美元的部分（如有）。

(选项A) 尽管房屋所有人以比投资者约定支付的价格高出20,000美元的价格将房屋出售给了商业竞争对手，但投资者不能自动获得这20,000美元的赔偿。这是因为投资者的预期利益是基于其自身的合同价格，而非其商业竞争对手的价格。

(选项B) 当不存在重大损失时，可以判处象征性损害赔偿（例如1美元）以作为违约的后果，但这并非因为无法获得实际履行救济。在本案中，投资者很可能确实遭受了重大损失，因为根据其商业竞争对手支付的120,000美元，该房屋的公平市价很可能超过了100,000美元。

(选项D) 期权通常是可转让的。但违反期权的损害赔偿等于未违约方的预期利益损失——这与可转让期权本身的公平市价是不同的（且可能更高）。

教学目的：

当卖方因拒绝向买方出售财产而违反土地买卖合同时，买方可以就交易损失获得赔偿，即违约当日该财产的公平市价与合同价格的差额。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 347 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a nonbreaching party's lost expectation is equal to the loss in value to him/her caused by the other party's failure to perform).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts & Remedies
核心考点：预期利益损害赔偿

在不动产买卖合同中，如果卖方违约，买方通常有权获得预期利益损害赔偿 (Expectation Damages)，即“交易的利益” (Benefit of the Bargain)。

赔偿金 = 违约时公平市价 (FMV) - 合同价格

1. 法律依据分析

本题的核心在于确定违约后的赔偿计算方式。题目要求假设投资者胜诉，这意味着我们不需要考虑合同是否有效成立的问题，只需关注救济措施 (Remedies)。

根据普通法规则，当卖方违反土地买卖合同时，买方的标准救济是让其处于“假如合同被履行时应处的经济地位”。

  • 合同价格：$100,000
  • 违约时价值：违约当日房屋的公平市价 (Fair Market Value, FMV)。

2. 为什么选项 C 是正确的？

选项 C 准确描述了预期利益的计算公式。

投资者本可以用 $100,000 买到房子。因为房主违约，投资者失去了一个价值为 FMV 的房子，但同时也省下了 $100,000 的购房款。

因此，投资者的净损失 = FMV - $100,000。

*注：如果 FMV 低于或等于 $100,000，则没有经济损失，赔偿额为零（或仅象征性赔偿）。

3. 陷阱选项解析

❌ 选项 A ($20,000 + ...)：
这是一个常见的诱导项。虽然房主以 $120,000 卖给了第三方（多赚了 $20k），但这 $120,000 只是证明 FMV 可能较高的一个证据，而不是法律规定的赔偿基准。
法律关注的是买方的损失（基于客观市场价值），而不是卖方的获利或第三方的出价。如果违约当日 FMV 实际上涨到了 $130,000，买方应得 $30,000，而不仅仅是 $20,000。

❌ 选项 B (象征性赔偿)：
仅当没有实际经济损失时才适用象征性赔偿 (Nominal Damages)。本题中，既然有竞争对手愿意出 $120,000，说明 FMV 很可能高于合同价 $100,000，因此存在实际损失。无法进行实际履行 (Specific Performance) 并不意味着只能获得象征性赔偿，它只是将救济方式转为了金钱赔偿。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：接受假设 题目中明确写道："Assume that... the investor prevails"（假设投资者胜诉）。

在做题时，千万不要去争辩“投资者还没付那100块钱，合同可能没生效”这个问题。一旦题目给出假设，必须基于该假设（即认定违约已成立）直接跳到下一步（计算赔偿）。这是 MBE 常见的考察“多层逻辑”的方式。

questions.question:
A landowner contracted in a signed writing to sell a 500-acre tract of farmland to a farmer. The contract provided for exchange of the deed and purchase price of $500,000 in cash on January 15. Possession was to be given to the farmer on the same date.
On January 15, the landowner notified the farmer that because the tenant on the farmland wrongfully refused to quit the premises until January 30, the landowner would be unable to deliver possession of the farmland until then, but he assured the farmer that he would tender the deed and possession on that date. When the landowner tendered the deed and possession on January 30, the farmer refused to accept either, and refused to pay the $500,000. Throughout the month of January, the market value of the farmland was $510,000, and its fair monthly rental value was $5,000.
Will the landowner likely succeed in an action against the farmer for specific performance?

choices.a: No, because the landowner breached by failing to tender the deed and possession on January 15.
choices.b: No, because the landowner's remedy at law for monetary relief is adequate.
choices.c: Yes, because the court will excuse the delay in tender on the ground that there was a temporary impossibility caused by the tenant's holding over.
choices.d: Yes, because time is ordinarily not of the essence in a land-sale contract.

questions.question:
A bakery contracted with a mill to provide 10,000 pounds of flour for $100,000. Prior to the date fixed for delivery of the flour, the mill, without justification, informed the bakery that it could not supply the flour. The bakery immediately sought and received a quote from a second source, who previously provided the bakery with flour in a timely and satisfactory manner. This source agreed to sell 10,000 pounds of flour for $120,000. Shortly after that, the bakery received a quote from a third source, who previously failed to deliver a promised order of flour to the bakery. The third source agreed to supply 10,000 pounds of flour for $100,000. Reasonably concerned that the third source would not provide the flour in a timely and satisfactory manner, the bakery contracted with the second source. Subsequently, the mill told the bakery that it could supply the flour by the original delivery date and provided the bakery with adequate evidence that the flour would be timely delivered. The bakery told the mill not to deliver the flour, instead acquiring it from the second source. The bakery sued the mill for $20,000.
Can the mill successfully defend against this action?

choices.a: No, because the bakery is entitled to recover the cost of acquiring substitute flour.
choices.b: No, because the mill lost the opportunity to supply the flour as soon as it repudiated its promise to deliver the flour.
choices.c: Yes, because the bakery was required to mitigate its damages by accepting the third source's lower offer.
choices.d: Yes, because the mill withdrew its repudiation prior to the time for performance.
